श्राद्धं कुर्याच्च पुत्रादिः(8) पितुर्जीवति तत्पितुः //
117.m: When this is recited at the beginning of an ancestral rite, the rite becomes complete and bestows the world of Brahmā. / And a son or other descendant should perform an ancestral rite for the father, [or] when he is living, for his father;

117.s:
tatpitustatpituḥ kuryājjīvati prapitāmahe /
pituḥ pitāmashasyātha parasya prapitāmāt(9) //
:n
1 kālamākhyāsye iti jha.. ca
2 śreṣṭhabhāgyapi iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / jyeṣṭhabhāgapi iti
gha..
3 navamyāṃ vai śaphapatiriti ja..
4 caturdaśyāñca śāstrata iti kha.. , gha.. ca
5 mṛtānāṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvāptiramāvāsyā samīritā iti ka..
6 daśārṇeṣu iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
7 te 'bhijātā iti kha.. , gha.. ca
8 kuryāt suputro 'pi iti cha..
9 tatpiturityādiḥ, prapitāmahādityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti
:p 20
117.d:
तत्पितुस्तत्पितुः कुर्याज्जीवति प्रपितामहे /
पितुः पितामस्हस्याथ परस्य प्रपितामात्(9) //
:न्
1 कालमाख्यास्ये इति झ.. च
2 श्रेष्ठभाग्यपि इति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. , छ.. च / ज्येष्ठभागपि इति
घ..
3 नवम्यां वै शफपतिरिति ज..
4 चतुर्दश्याञ्च शास्त्रत इति ख.. , घ.. च
5 मृतानां श्राद्धं सर्वाप्तिरमावास्या समीरिता इति क..
6 दशार्णेषु इति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
7 ते ऽभिजाता इति ख.. , घ.. च
8 कुर्यात् सुपुत्रो ऽपि इति छ..
9 तत्पितुरित्यादिः, प्रपितामहादित्यन्तः पाठो झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 20
117.m:
he should perform it for that one's father, and for his father when the great-grandfather is living; / or for the father, the grandfather, and the one beyond the great-grandfather.
[Footnotes]
1 kālamākhyāsye in manuscript jha.
2 śreṣṭhabhāgyapi in manuscripts kha, ga, ṅa, and cha; jyeṣṭhabhāgapi in manuscript gha.
3 navamyāṃ vai śaphapatiḥ in manuscript ja.
4 caturdaśyāñca śāstrataḥ in manuscripts kha and gha.
5 mṛtānāṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvāptiramāvāsyā samīritā in manuscript ka.
6 daśārṇeṣu in manuscripts kha, ga, ṅa, and cha.
7 te 'bhijātāḥ in manuscripts kha and gha.
8 kuryāt suputro 'pi in manuscript cha.
9 The text from tatpituḥ up to prapitāmahāt is not in manuscript jha.

117.s:
evaṃ mātrādikasyāpi tathā mātāmahādike /
śrāddhakalpaṃ paṭhedyastu sa labhet śrāddhakṛtphalaṃ(1) //
117.d:
एवं मात्रादिकस्यापि तथा मातामहादिके /
श्राद्धकल्पं पठेद्यस्तु स लभेत् श्राद्धकृत्फलं(1) //
117.m: Likewise for the mother and others, as well as for the maternal grandfather and others. / Whoever recites this procedure of the ancestral rite obtains the fruit of one who performs the ancestral rite.

117.s:
tīrthe yugādau manvādau śrāddhaṃ dattamathākṣayaṃ /
aśvayucchuklanavamī dvādaśī kartike tathā //
117.d:
तीर्थे युगादौ मन्वादौ श्राद्धं दत्तमथाक्षयं /
अश्वयुच्छुक्लनवमी द्वादशी कर्तिके तथा //
117.m: An ancestral rite offered at a sacred ford, at the beginning of a Yuga, or at the beginning of a Manvantara is inexhaustible; / likewise on the bright ninth of Aśvina, and on the twelfth of Kārttika;

117.s:
tṛtīyā caiva māghasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca /
phālgunasyāpyamāvāsyā pauṣayaikādaśī tathā //
117.d:
तृतीया चैव माघस्य तथा भाद्रपदस्य च /
फाल्गुनस्याप्यमावास्या पौषयैकादशी तथा //
117.m: and on the third of Māgha, and likewise of Bhādrapada; / the new moon of Phālguna, and the eleventh of Pauṣa;

117.s:
āṣāḍhasyāpi daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī /
śrāvaṇe cāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhe ca pūrṇimā //
117.d:
आषाढस्यापि दशमी माघमासस्य सप्तमी /
श्रावणे चाष्टमी कृष्णा तथाषाढे च पूर्णिमा //
117.m: the tenth of Āṣāḍha, the seventh of the month of Māgha, / the dark eighth in Śrāvaṇa, and the full moon in Āṣāḍha;

117.s:
kartikī phālgunī tadvaj jyaiṣṭhe pañcadaśī sitā /
svāyambhuvādyā manavasteṣāmādyāḥ kilākṣayāḥ //
117.d:
कर्तिकी फाल्गुनी तद्वज् ज्यैष्ठे पञ्चदशी सिता /
स्वायम्भुवाद्या मनवस्तेषामाद्याः किलाक्षयाः //
117.m: likewise the full moon of Kārttika, of Phālguna, and the bright fifteenth in Jyaiṣṭha. / These initial days of the Manus, beginning with Svāyambhuva, are indeed inexhaustible.

117.s:
gayā prayāgo gaṅgā ca kurukṣetraṃ ca narmadā /
śrīparvataḥ prabhāsaś ca śālagrāmo varāṇasī(2) //
117.d:
गया प्रयागो गङ्गा च कुरुक्षेत्रं च नर्मदा /
श्रीपर्वतः प्रभासश् च शालग्रामो वराणसी(2) //
117.m: Gayā, Prayāga, the Gaṅgā, Kurukṣetra, and the Narmadā, / Śrīparvata, Prabhāsa, Śālagrāma, Vārāṇasī,

117.s:
godāvarī teṣu śrāddhaṃ strīpuruṣottamādiṣu //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe śrāddhakalpo nāma saptadaśādhikaśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
bhāratavarṣaṃ
117.d:
गोदावरी तेषु श्राद्धं स्त्रीपुरुषोत्तमादिषु //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे श्राद्धकल्पो नाम सप्तदशाधिकशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टादशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
भारतवर्षं
117.m:
the Godāvarī—an ancestral rite performed at these and at Puruṣottama [bestows liberation] to women and men.
Thus in the Great Agni Purāṇa, the one hundred and seventeenth chapter, entitled “The Procedure for Ancestral Rites.”
Now, the one hundred and eighteenth chapter.
Bhāratavarṣa.

118.s:
agnir uvāca
uttaraṃ yat samudrasya himādreś caiva dakṣiṇaṃ /
varṣaṃ tad bhārataṃ nāma navasāhasravistṛtaṃ //
118.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
उत्तरं यत् समुद्रस्य हिमाद्रेश् चैव दक्षिणं /
वर्षं तद् भारतं नाम नवसाहस्रविस्तृतं //
118.m: Agni said: / That realm lying north of the ocean and south of the snow-clad mountains / is named Bhārata, extending nine thousand [yojanas].

118.s:
karmabhūmiriyaṃ svargamapavargaṃ ca gacchatāṃ /
:n
1 yastu labhecchrāddhakṛtaṃ phalamiti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
2 vārāṇasī iti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
:p 21
mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimān hemaparvataḥ(1) //
118.d:
कर्मभूमिरियं स्वर्गमपवर्गं च गच्छतां /
:न्
1 यस्तु लभेच्छ्राद्धकृतं फलमिति ख.. , छ.. , ज.. च
2 वाराणसी इति ख.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
:प् 21
महेन्द्रो मलयः सह्यः शुक्तिमान् हेमपर्वतः(1) //
118.m:
This is the land of action for those going to heaven and liberation.
[Footnotes]
1 yastu labhecchrāddhakṛtaṃ phalam in manuscripts kha, cha, and ja.
2 vārāṇasī in manuscripts kha, ṅa, cha, and ja.
Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Śuktimān, the Hemaparvata,

118.s:
vindhyaś ca pāripātraś ca saptātra kulaparvatāḥ /
indradvīpaḥ kaseruś ca tāmravarṇo gabhastimān //
118.d:
विन्ध्यश् च पारिपात्रश् च सप्तात्र कुलपर्वताः /
इन्द्रद्वीपः कसेरुश् च ताम्रवर्णो गभस्तिमान् //
118.m: Vindhya, and Pāripātra—these are the seven clan mountain-ranges here. / Indradvīpa, Kaseru, Tāmravarṇa, Gabhastimān,

118.s:
nāgadvīpas tathā saumyo gāndharvastvatha vāruṇaḥ /
ayaṃ tu navamasteṣu dvīpaḥ sāgarasaṃvṛtaḥ //
118.d:
नागद्वीपस् तथा सौम्यो गान्धर्वस्त्वथ वारुणः /
अयं तु नवमस्तेषु द्वीपः सागरसंवृतः //
118.m: Nāgadvīpa, Saumya, Gāndharva, and Vāruṇa: / this, surrounded by the ocean, is the ninth division among them.

118.s:
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi dvīpoyaṃ dakṣiṇottarāt /
nava bhedā bhāratasya(2) madhyabhede 'tha pūrvataḥ //
118.d:
योजनानां सहस्राणि द्वीपोयं दक्षिणोत्तरात् /
नव भेदा भारतस्य(2) मध्यभेदे ऽथ पूर्वतः //
118.m: This division measures thousands of yojanas from south to north. / There are nine divisions of Bhārata; now in the central division, to the east

118.s:
kirātā yavanāścāpi brāhmaṇādyāś ca madhyataḥ /
vedasmṛtimukhā nadyaḥ pāripātrodbhavās tathā //
118.d:
किराता यवनाश्चापि ब्राह्मणाद्याश् च मध्यतः /
वेदस्मृतिमुखा नद्यः पारिपात्रोद्भवास् तथा //
118.m: dwell the Kirātas; [to the west] the Yavanas; and in the center are the Brahmins and others. / The rivers beginning with the Vedasmṛti originate from the Pāripātra;

118.s:
vindhyācca narmadādyāḥ syuḥ sahyāttāpī payoṣṇikā /
godāvarībhīmarathīkṛṣṇaveṇādikās tathā //
118.d:
विन्ध्याच्च नर्मदाद्याः स्युः सह्यात्तापी पयोष्णिका /
गोदावरीभीमरथीकृष्णवेणादिकास् तथा //
118.m: those beginning with the Narmadā arise from the Vindhya; from the Sahya arise the Tāpī, the Payoṣṇikā, / the Godāvarī, the Bhīmarathī, the Kṛṣṇaveṇā, and others;

118.s:
malayāt kṛtamālādyāstrisāmādyā mahendrajāḥ /
kumārādyāḥ śuktimato(3) himādreś candrabhāgakā //
118.d:
मलयात् कृतमालाद्यास्त्रिसामाद्या महेन्द्रजाः /
कुमाराद्याः शुक्तिमतो(3) हिमाद्रेश् चन्द्रभागका //
118.m: from the Malaya, the Kṛtamālā and others; from the Mahendra, the Trisāmā and others; / from the Śuktimat, the Kumārā and others; and from the snow-mountain, the Candrabhāgā.

118.s:
paścime kurupāñcālamadhyadeśādayaḥsthitāḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe bhāratavarṣaṃ
nāmāṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athaikonaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
mahādvīpādi
118.d:
पश्चिमे कुरुपाञ्चालमध्यदेशादयःस्थिताः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे भारतवर्षं
नामाष्टादशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथैकोनविंशत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
महाद्वीपादि
118.m:
In the west are situated the Kurus, the Pañcālas, the Madhyadeśa, and others.
Thus in the Great Agni Purāṇa, the one hundred and eighteenth chapter, entitled “Bhāratavarṣa.”
Now, the one hundred nineteenth chapter:
The Great Continents and the Rest.

119.s:
agnir uvāca
lakṣayojanavistāraṃ jambūdvīpaṃ samāvṛtam /
:n
1 śaktimānṛkṣaparvata iti gha.. , cha.. ca / śuktimānṛkṣaparvata iti
ja..
2 nava bhedā bhavantyasyeti jha..
3 śaktimata iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , jha.. ca
:p 22
lakṣyayojanamanena kṣīrodena samantataḥ //
119.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
लक्षयोजनविस्तारं जम्बूद्वीपं समावृतम् /
:न्
1 शक्तिमानृक्षपर्वत इति घ.. , छ.. च / शुक्तिमानृक्षपर्वत इति
ज..
2 नव भेदा भवन्त्यस्येति झ..
3 शक्तिमत इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , झ.. च
:प् 22
लक्ष्ययोजनमनेन क्षीरोदेन समन्ततः //
119.m:
Agni said: / Jambūdvīpa, a hundred thousand yojanas in extent, is surrounded
:n
1 "śaktimānṛkṣaparvata" in manuscripts gha and cha; "śuktimānṛkṣaparvata" in ja.
2 "nava bhedā bhavantyasya" in manuscript jha.
3 "śaktimata" in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, and jha. / :p 22
completely on all sides by the Salt Ocean of one hundred thousand yojanas.

119.s:
saṃveṣṭya kṣāramudadhiṃ plakṣadvīpas tathā sthitaḥ(1) /
sapta medhātitheḥ putrāḥ plakṣadvīpeśvarās tathā //
119.d:
संवेष्ट्य क्षारमुदधिं प्लक्षद्वीपस् तथा स्थितः(1) /
सप्त मेधातिथेः पुत्राः प्लक्षद्वीपेश्वरास् तथा //
119.m: Encompassing that salt ocean stands Plakṣadvīpa. / Medhātithi had seven sons, who were the lords of Plakṣadvīpa.

119.s:
syācchāntabhayaḥ śiśiraḥ sukhodaya itaḥ paraḥ /
ānandaś ca śivaḥ kṣemo dhruvastannāmavarṣakaṃ //
119.d:
स्याच्छान्तभयः शिशिरः सुखोदय इतः परः /
आनन्दश् च शिवः क्षेमो ध्रुवस्तन्नामवर्षकं //
119.m: They are Śāntabhaya, Śiśira, Sukhodaya, and beyond this / Ānanda, Śiva, Kṣema, and Dhruva; the realms are named after them.

119.s:
maryādāśailo gomedhaś candro nāradadundbhī /
somakaḥ sumanāḥ śailo vaibhrājāstajjanāḥ śubhāḥ //
119.d:
मर्यादाशैलो गोमेधश् चन्द्रो नारददुन्द्भी /
सोमकः सुमनाः शैलो वैभ्राजास्तज्जनाः शुभाः //
119.m: Its boundary mountains are Gomedha, Candra, Nārada, Dundubhi, / Somaka, Sumanas, and Mount Vaibhrāja; its people are auspicious.

119.s:
nadyaḥ pradhānāḥ saptātra plakṣācchākāntikeṣu ca /
jīvanaṃ pañcasāsraṃ dharmo varṇāśramātmakaḥ(2) //
119.d:
नद्यः प्रधानाः सप्तात्र प्लक्षाच्छाकान्तिकेषु च /
जीवनं पञ्चसास्रं धर्मो वर्णाश्रमात्मकः(2) //
119.m: Here, seven chief rivers flow in the region extending from Plakṣa up to Śāka. / Lifespan is five thousand [years], and dharma consists of the varṇas and āśramas.

119.s:
āryakāḥ kuravaś caiva viviṃśā bhāvinaś ca te /
viprādyāstaiś ca somo 'rcyo dvilakṣaścābdhilakṣakaḥ //
119.d:
आर्यकाः कुरवश् चैव विविंशा भाविनश् च ते /
विप्राद्यास्तैश् च सोमो ऽर्च्यो द्विलक्षश्चाब्धिलक्षकः //
119.m: The Āryakas, Kurus, Viviṃśas, and Bhāvins / are the brāhmaṇas and other classes; by them Soma is to be worshipped. It is two hundred thousand [yojanas in extent], and the ocean is a hundred thousand.

119.s:
mānenekṣurasodena vṛto dviguṇaśālmalaḥ /
vapuṣmataḥ sapta putrāḥ śālmaleśās tathābhavan //
119.d:
मानेनेक्षुरसोदेन वृतो द्विगुणशाल्मलः /
वपुष्मतः सप्त पुत्राः शाल्मलेशास् तथाभवन् //
119.m: Surrounded by the Ocean of Sugarcane-Juice, twice that in size is Śālmala. / Vapuṣmat had seven sons, who likewise became the lords of Śālmala:

119.s:
śveto 'tha haritaś caiva jīmūto lohitaḥ kramāt /
vaidyuto mānasaś caiva suprabho nāma varṣakaḥ //
119.d:
श्वेतो ऽथ हरितश् चैव जीमूतो लोहितः क्रमात् /
वैद्युतो मानसश् चैव सुप्रभो नाम वर्षकः //
119.m: Śveta, Harita, Jīmūta, Lohita in order, / Vaidyuta, Mānasa, and the realm named Suprabha.

119.s:
dviguṇo dviguṇenaiva surodena samāvṛtaḥ /
kumudaścānalaś caiva(3) tṛtīyastu valāhakaḥ //
119.d:
द्विगुणो द्विगुणेनैव सुरोदेन समावृतः /
कुमुदश्चानलश् चैव(3) तृतीयस्तु वलाहकः //
119.m: Twice that in size, it is surrounded by the Ocean of Wine of equal extent. / Kumuda, Anala, and third Valāhaka,

119.s:
droṇaḥ kaṃko 'tha(4) mahiṣaḥ kakudmān sapta nimnagāḥ /
kapilāścāruṇāḥ pītāḥ kṛṣṇāḥsyurbrāhmaṇādayaḥ //
119.d:
द्रोणः कंको ऽथ(4) महिषः ककुद्मान् सप्त निम्नगाः /
कपिलाश्चारुणाः पीताः कृष्णाःस्युर्ब्राह्मणादयः //
119.m: Droṇa, Kaṅka, Mahiṣa, and Kakudmat are the seven mountains. / The brāhmaṇas and other classes are the Kapilas, Aruṇas, Pītas, and Kṛṣṇas;

119.s:
vāyurūpaṃ yajanti sma surodenāyamāvṛtaḥ(5) /
:n
1 dvīpas tathā smṛta iti jha..
2 varṇāśramātmaja iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
3 kumudaśconnataś caiveti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
4 karko 'theti ka..
5 surodena samāvṛta iti gha..
:p 23
jyotiṣmataḥ kuśeśāḥ syurudgijo dhenumān sutaḥ //
119.d:
वायुरूपं यजन्ति स्म सुरोदेनायमावृतः(5) /
:न्
1 द्वीपस् तथा स्मृत इति झ..
2 वर्णाश्रमात्मज इति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. च
3 कुमुदश्चोन्नतश् चैवेति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
4 कर्को ऽथेति क..
5 सुरोदेन समावृत इति घ..
:प् 23
ज्योतिष्मतः कुशेशाः स्युरुद्गिजो धेनुमान् सुतः //
119.m:
they used to worship [the Lord] in the form of Vāyu. This [continent] is surrounded by the Ocean of Wine.
:n
1 "dvīpas tathā smṛtaḥ" in manuscript jha.
2 "varṇāśramātmajaḥ" in manuscripts kha, gha, and ja.
3 "kumudaśconnataś caiva" in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, and ṅa.
4 "karko 'tha" in manuscript ka.
5 "surodena samāvṛtaḥ" in manuscript gha. / :p 23
The sons of Jyotiṣmat are the lords of Kuśa: Udbhid, Dhenumat,

119.s:
dvairatho laṃvano dhairyaḥ kapilaś ca prabhākaraḥ /
viprādyā dadhimukhyāstu brahmarūpaṃ yajanti te //
119.d:
द्वैरथो लंवनो धैर्यः कपिलश् च प्रभाकरः /
विप्राद्या दधिमुख्यास्तु ब्रह्मरूपं यजन्ति ते //
119.m: Dvairatha, Lavaṇa, Dhairya, Kapila, and Prabhākara. / The brāhmaṇas and others, chief among whom are the Dadhis, worship [the Lord] in the form of Brahmā.

119.s:
vidrumo(1) hemaśailaś ca dyutimān puṣpavāṃs tathā /
kuśeśayo hariḥ śailo varṣārthaṃ mandarācalaḥ //
119.d:
विद्रुमो(1) हेमशैलश् च द्युतिमान् पुष्पवांस् तथा /
कुशेशयो हरिः शैलो वर्षार्थं मन्दराचलः //
119.m: Vidruma, the Golden Mountain, Dyutimat, Puṣpavat, / Kuśeśaya, Mount Hari, and Mount Mandara define the realms.

119.s:
veṣṭito 'yaṃ ghṛtodena krauñcadvīpena so 'pyatha /
krauñceśvarāḥ dyutimataḥ putrāstannāmavarṣakāḥ //
119.d:
वेष्टितो ऽयं घृतोदेन क्रौञ्चद्वीपेन सो ऽप्यथ /
क्रौञ्चेश्वराः द्युतिमतः पुत्रास्तन्नामवर्षकाः //
119.m: This continent is surrounded by the Ocean of Clarified Butter, and that in turn by Krauñcadvīpa. / The sons of Dyutimat were the lords of Krauñca, and the realms bear their names:

119.s:
kuśalo manonugaścoṣṇaḥ pradhāno 'thāndhakārakaḥ /
muniś ca dundubhiḥ sapta sapta śailāś ca nimnagāḥ(2) //
119.d:
कुशलो मनोनुगश्चोष्णः प्रधानो ऽथान्धकारकः /
मुनिश् च दुन्दुभिः सप्त सप्त शैलाश् च निम्नगाः(2) //
119.m: Kuśala, Manonuga, Uṣṇa, Pradhāna, Andhakāraka, / Muni, and Dundubhi—these are the seven. There are also seven mountains and rivers:

119.s:
krauñcaś ca vāmnaś caiva tṛtīyaścāndhakārakaḥ(3) /
devavṛt puṇḍarīkaś ca dundubhirdviguṇo mithaḥ //
119.d:
क्रौञ्चश् च वाम्नश् चैव तृतीयश्चान्धकारकः(3) /
देववृत् पुण्डरीकश् च दुन्दुभिर्द्विगुणो मिथः //
119.m: Krauñca, Vāmana, third Andhakāraka, / Devavṛt, Puṇḍarīka, and Dundubhi. [Each continent] is twice the size of the preceding.

119.s:
dvīpā dvīpeṣu ye śailā yathā dvīpāni te tathā /
puṣkarāḥ puṣkalā dhanyāstīrthā(4) viprādayo harim //
119.d:
द्वीपा द्वीपेषु ये शैला यथा द्वीपानि ते तथा /
पुष्कराः पुष्कला धन्यास्तीर्था(4) विप्रादयो हरिम् //
119.m: The mountains that exist in the continents correspond to the continents [in size]. / The Puṣkaras, Puṣkalas, Dhanyas, and Tīrthas are the brāhmaṇas and other classes; they worship Hari.

119.s:
yajanti krauñcadvīpastu dadhimaṇḍodakāvṛtaḥ /
saṃvṛtaḥ śākadvīpena havyācchākeśvarāḥ sutāḥ //
119.d:
यजन्ति क्रौञ्चद्वीपस्तु दधिमण्डोदकावृतः /
संवृतः शाकद्वीपेन हव्याच्छाकेश्वराः सुताः //
119.m: Krauñcadvīpa is surrounded by the Ocean of Curds; / that in turn is enclosed by Śākadvīpa. The sons of Bhavya were the lords of Śāka:

119.s:
jaladaś ca kumāraś ca sukumāro maṇīvakaḥ /
kuśottaratho modākī drumastannāmavarṣakāḥ //
119.d:
जलदश् च कुमारश् च सुकुमारो मणीवकः /
कुशोत्तरथो मोदाकी द्रुमस्तन्नामवर्षकाः //
119.m: Jalada, Kumāra, Sukumāra, Maṇīvaka, / Kuśottara, Modākī, and Druma; the realms bear their names.

119.s:
udayākhyo jaladharo raivataḥ śyāmakodrakau /
āmvikeyas tathā ramyaḥ keśarī sapta nimnagāḥ //
:n
1 rudrābha iti ka.. / vikrama iti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 kuśala ity ādiḥ, nimnagā ity antaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti
3 tṛtīyaścānukāraka iti gha.. , jha.. ca
4 puṣkalāvatyāṃ tīrthā iti gha..
:p 24
119.d:
उदयाख्यो जलधरो रैवतः श्यामकोद्रकौ /
आम्विकेयस् तथा रम्यः केशरी सप्त निम्नगाः //
:न्
1 रुद्राभ इति क.. / विक्रम इति ख.. , छ.. च
2 कुशल इत्य् आदिः, निम्नगा इत्य् अन्तः पाठो झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
3 तृतीयश्चानुकारक इति घ.. , झ.. च
4 पुष्कलावत्यां तीर्था इति घ..
:प् 24
119.m:
Mount Udaya, Jaladhara, Raivata, Śyāmaka, Astra, / Āmbikeya, Ramya, and Keśarin [are its mountains], and there are seven rivers.
:n
1 "rudrābha" in manuscript ka; "vikrama" in kha and cha.
2 The passage beginning with "kuśala" and ending with "nimnagāḥ" is not present in manuscript jha.
3 "tṛtīyaścānukāraka" in manuscripts gha and jha.
4 "puṣkalāvatyāṃ tīrthā" in manuscript gha. / :p 24

119.s:
magā magadhamanasyā(1) mandagāś ca dvijātayaḥ(2) /
yajanti sūryarūpaṃ tu(3) śākaḥ kṣīrābdhinā vṛtaḥ //
119.d:
मगा मगधमनस्या(1) मन्दगाश् च द्विजातयः(2) /
यजन्ति सूर्यरूपं तु(3) शाकः क्षीराब्धिना वृतः //
119.m: The Magas, Magadhas, Mānasas, and Mandagas are the twice-born classes; / they worship [the Lord] in the form of the Sun. Śāka is surrounded by the Ocean of Milk.

119.s:
puṣkareṇāvṛtaḥ so 'pi dvau putrau savanasya ca /
masāvīto dhātakiś ca varṣe dve nāmacihnite(4) //
119.d:
पुष्करेणावृतः सो ऽपि द्वौ पुत्रौ सवनस्य च /
मसावीतो धातकिश् च वर्षे द्वे नामचिह्निते(4) //
119.m: That too is surrounded by Puṣkara. Savana had two sons: / Mahāvīta and Dhātaki; the two realms are designated by their names.

119.s:
eko 'drirmānasākhyo 'tra madhyato valayākṛtiḥ /
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi vistārocchrāyataḥ samaḥ //
119.d:
एको ऽद्रिर्मानसाख्यो ऽत्र मध्यतो वलयाकृतिः /
योजनानां सहस्राणि विस्तारोच्छ्रायतः समः //
119.m: Here there is a single mountain named Mānasa, circular in shape in the middle, / equal in extent and height to thousands of yojanas.

119.s:
jīvanaṃ daśasāhasraṃ surair brahmātra pūjyate /
svādūdakenodadhinā veṣṭito dvīpamānataḥ //
119.d:
जीवनं दशसाहस्रं सुरैर् ब्रह्मात्र पूज्यते /
स्वादूदकेनोदधिना वेष्टितो द्वीपमानतः //
119.m: The lifespan is ten thousand [years]. Brahmā is worshipped here by the gods. / It is surrounded by the Ocean of Fresh Water, according to the extent of the continent.

119.s:
ūnātiriktatā cāpāṃ samudreṣu na jāyate /
udayāstamaneṣvindoḥ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ //
119.d:
ऊनातिरिक्तता चापां समुद्रेषु न जायते /
उदयास्तमनेष्विन्दोः पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः //
119.m: No deficiency or excess occurs in the waters of the oceans, / [except] at the rising and setting of the moon during the bright and dark fortnights.

119.s:
daśottarāṇi pañcaiva(5) aṅgulānāṃ śatāni vai /
apāṃ vṛddhikṣayau dṛṣṭau sāmudrīṇāṃ(6) mahāmune //
119.d:
दशोत्तराणि पञ्चैव(5) अङ्गुलानां शतानि वै /
अपां वृद्धिक्षयौ दृष्टौ सामुद्रीणां(6) महामुने //
119.m: An increase and decrease of five hundred and ten aṅgulas / is indeed seen in the waters of the oceans, O great sage.

119.s:
svādūdakā bahuguṇā(7) bhūrhaimī jantuvarjitā /
lokālokastataḥ śailo yojanāyutavistṛtaḥ //
119.d:
स्वादूदका बहुगुणा(7) भूर्हैमी जन्तुवर्जिता /
लोकालोकस्ततः शैलो योजनायुतविस्तृतः //
119.m: Beyond the Fresh Water Ocean is the golden land, manifold [in size], devoid of living creatures. / Beyond that is Mount Lokāloka, ten thousand yojanas broad.

119.s:
lokālokastu tamasāvṛto 'thāṇḍakaṭāhataḥ /
bhūmiḥ sāṇḍakaṭāhena pañcāśatkoṭivistarā(8) //
:e ity āgneye mahapurāṇe dvīpādivarṇanaṃ
nāmaikonaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 āgāmyagadhamālasyā iti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 dvijādaya iti ka.. , kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca
3 sūryarūpante iti gha.. , ja.. ca
4 varṣe dve bhāgacihnite iti jha..
5 pañcātreti ga.. , ṅa.. ca
6 samudrāṇāmiti ga.. , ṅa.. , jha.. ca
7 svādūdakā dvitriguṇeti kha.. , cha.. ca / svādūdakā tu dviguṇeti gha.. ,
ja.. ca / svādūdakā tu dviguṇeti ga.. , ṅa.. ca
8 pañcāśatkoṭivistṛteti cha..
:p 25
:ś atha viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
bhuvanakoṣaḥ
119.d:
लोकालोकस्तु तमसावृतो ऽथाण्डकटाहतः /
भूमिः साण्डकटाहेन पञ्चाशत्कोटिविस्तरा(8) //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महपुराणे द्वीपादिवर्णनं
नामैकोनविंशत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 आगाम्यगधमालस्या इति ख.. , छ.. च
2 द्विजादय इति क.. , ख.. , ग.. , छ.. च
3 सूर्यरूपन्ते इति घ.. , ज.. च
4 वर्षे द्वे भागचिह्निते इति झ..
5 पञ्चात्रेति ग.. , ङ.. च
6 समुद्राणामिति ग.. , ङ.. , झ.. च
7 स्वादूदका द्वित्रिगुणेति ख.. , छ.. च / स्वादूदका तु द्विगुणेति घ.. ,
ज.. च / स्वादूदका तु द्विगुणेति ग.. , ङ.. च
8 पञ्चाशत्कोटिविस्तृतेति छ..
:प् 25
:श् अथ विंशत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
भुवनकोषः
119.m:
Lokāloka is enveloped in darkness up to the caldron of the Cosmic Egg. / Including the caldron of the Cosmic Egg, the earth extends fifty crore [yojanas].
:e Thus in the great Agni Purāṇa, the one hundred nineteenth chapter, entitled "Description of the Continents and Other Regions."
:n
1 "āgāmyagadhamālasyā" in manuscripts kha and cha.
2 "dvijādaya" in manuscripts ka, kha, ga, and cha.
3 "sūryarūpante" in manuscripts gha and ja.
4 "varṣe dve bhāgacihnite" in manuscript jha.
5 "pañcātra" in manuscripts ga and ṅa.
6 "samudrāṇām" in manuscripts ga, ṅa, and jha.
7 "svādūdakā dvitriguṇā" in manuscripts kha and cha; "svādūdakā tu dviguṇā" in manuscripts ga, gha, ṅa, and ja.
8 "pañcāśatkoṭivistṛtā" in manuscript cha. / :p 25
Now, the one hundred twentieth chapter:
Description of the Cosmic Sphere

120.s:
agnir uvāca
vistārastu smṛto bhūmeḥ sahasrāṇi ca saptatiḥ /
ucchrāyo daśasāhasraṃ pātālañcaikamekakaṃ //
120.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
विस्तारस्तु स्मृतो भूमेः सहस्राणि च सप्ततिः /
उच्छ्रायो दशसाहस्रं पातालञ्चैकमेककं //
120.m: Agni said: / The extent of the earth is recorded as seventy thousand [yojanas], / and the height of each single netherworld (pātāla) is ten thousand.

120.s:
atalaṃ vitalañcaiva nitalañca gabhastimat /
mahākhyaṃ sutalañcāgryaṃ pātālañcāpi saptamaṃ //
120.d:
अतलं वितलञ्चैव नितलञ्च गभस्तिमत् /
महाख्यं सुतलञ्चाग्र्यं पातालञ्चापि सप्तमं //
120.m: Atala, Vitala, Nitala, Gabhastimat, / Mahākhya, the foremost Sutala, and Pātāla as the seventh.

120.s:
kṛṣṇapītāruṇāḥ śuklaśarkarāśailakāñcanāḥ /
bhūmayasteṣu ramyeṣu santi daityādayaḥ sukhaṃ //
120.d:
कृष्णपीतारुणाः शुक्लशर्कराशैलकाञ्चनाः /
भूमयस्तेषु रम्येषु सन्ति दैत्यादयः सुखं //
120.m: The soils in these delightful [realms] are black, yellow, red, white, gravelly, rocky, and golden; / in them the Daityas and others dwell happily.

120.s:
pātālānāmadhaścāste śeṣo viṣṇuś ca tāmasaḥ /
guṇānantyātsa cānantataḥ śirasā dhārayanmahīṃ //
120.d:
पातालानामधश्चास्ते शेषो विष्णुश् च तामसः /
गुणानन्त्यात्स चानन्ततः शिरसा धारयन्महीं //
120.m: And beneath the netherworlds dwells Śeṣa, Viṣṇu in his tamas quality, / and he is Ananta ('Infinite') on account of the infinity of his virtues, bearing the earth upon his head.

120.s:
bhuvo 'dho narakā naike na patettatra vaiṣṇavaḥ /
raviṇā bhāsitā pṛthvī yāvattāyannabho mataṃ //
120.d:
भुवो ऽधो नरका नैके न पतेत्तत्र वैष्णवः /
रविणा भासिता पृथ्वी यावत्तायन्नभो मतं //
120.m: Beneath the earth are multiple hells; a Vaiṣṇava does not fall there. / As far as the earth is illumined by the sun, so far the sky is considered [to extend].

120.s:
bhūmeryojanalakṣantu viśiṣṭharavimaṇḍalaṃ /
raver lakṣeṇa candraś ca lakṣānnākṣatramindutaḥ //
120.d:
भूमेर्योजनलक्षन्तु विशिष्ठरविमण्डलं /
रवेर् लक्षेण चन्द्रश् च लक्षान्नाक्षत्रमिन्दुतः //
120.m: One hundred thousand yojanas from the earth is the distinct solar orb; / the moon is one hundred thousand [yojanas] from the sun, and the asterisms are one hundred thousand from the moon.

120.s:
dvilakṣādbhādbudhaścāste budhācchukro dvilakṣataḥ /
dvilakṣeṇa kujaḥ śukrādbhaumād dvilakṣato guruḥ //
120.d:
द्विलक्षाद्भाद्बुधश्चास्ते बुधाच्छुक्रो द्विलक्षतः /
द्विलक्षेण कुजः शुक्राद्भौमाद् द्विलक्षतो गुरुः //
120.m: Mercury dwells two hundred thousand [yojanas] from the asterisms, and Venus two hundred thousand from Mercury; / Mars is two hundred thousand from Venus, and Jupiter two hundred thousand from Mars.

120.s:
gurordvilakṣataḥ sauritllakṣātsaptarṣayaḥ śaneḥ /
lakṣād dhruvo hy ṛṣibhyastu trailokyañcocchrayeṇa ca //
120.d:
गुरोर्द्विलक्षतः सौरित्ल्लक्षात्सप्तर्षयः शनेः /
लक्षाद् ध्रुवो ह्य् ऋषिभ्यस्तु त्रैलोक्यञ्चोच्छ्रयेण च //
120.m: Saturn is two hundred thousand from Jupiter, the Seven Sages are one hundred thousand from Saturn, / and Dhruva is one hundred thousand from the sages; and such is the height of the three worlds.

120.s:
dhruvāt koṭyā maharloko yatra te kalpavāsinaḥ /
:p 26
jano dvikoṭitastasmādyatrāsan(1) sanakādayaḥ //
120.d:
ध्रुवात् कोट्या महर्लोको यत्र ते कल्पवासिनः /
:प् 26
जनो द्विकोटितस्तस्माद्यत्रासन्(1) सनकादयः //
120.m:
Ten million [yojanas] from Dhruva is Maharloka, where dwell those who abide for a kalpa.
[Page 26]
Twenty million [yojanas] from that is Janaloka, where Sanaka and the others resided.

120.s:
janāttapaścāṣtakoṭyā vairājā yatra devatāḥ /
ṣaṇavatyā tu koṭīnāntapasaḥ satyalokakaḥ //
120.d:
जनात्तपश्चाष्तकोट्या वैराजा यत्र देवताः /
षणवत्या तु कोटीनान्तपसः सत्यलोककः //
120.m: Eighty million [yojanas] from Jana is Tapas, where the Vairāja deities dwell; / and Satyaloka is ninety-six million [yojanas] from Tapas.

120.s:
apunarmārakā yatra brahmaloko hi sa smṛtaḥ /
pādagamyastu bhūlloko bhuvaḥ sūryāntaraḥ smṛtaḥ //
120.d:
अपुनर्मारका यत्र ब्रह्मलोको हि स स्मृतः /
पादगम्यस्तु भूल्लोको भुवः सूर्यान्तरः स्मृतः //
120.m: Where dwellers are free from rebirth, that is recorded as Brahmaloka. / Bhūrloka is accessible on foot; Bhuvarloka is recorded as the interval up to the sun.

120.s:
svargaloko dhruvāntastu niyutāni(2) caturdaśa /
etadaṇḍakaṭāhena vṛto brahmāṇḍavistaraḥ //
120.d:
स्वर्गलोको ध्रुवान्तस्तु नियुतानि(2) चतुर्दश /
एतदण्डकटाहेन वृतो ब्रह्माण्डविस्तरः //
120.m: Svargaloka extends up to Dhruva, one million four hundred thousand [yojanas]. / This is the extent of the cosmic egg, enclosed by the shell of the egg.

120.s:
vārivahnyanilākāśaistato bhūtādinā vahiḥ /
vṛtaṃ daśaguṇair aṇḍaṃ bhūtādirmahatā tathā //
120.d:
वारिवह्न्यनिलाकाशैस्ततो भूतादिना वहिः /
वृतं दशगुणैर् अण्डं भूतादिर्महता तथा //
120.m: The egg is enveloped from outside by water, fire, wind, and ether, then by ego (bhūtādi), / each ten times greater; likewise, the ego by the intellect (mahat).

120.s:
daśottarāṇi śeṣāṇi ekaikasmānmāmune /
mahāntañca samāvṛtya pradhānaṃ samavasthitaṃ //
120.d:
दशोत्तराणि शेषाणि एकैकस्मान्मामुने /
महान्तञ्च समावृत्य प्रधानं समवस्थितं //
120.m: The remaining [envelopes] are each ten times greater than the preceding one, O great sage; / and having enveloped the intellect, the primordial matter (pradhāna) stands firm.

120.s:
anantasya na tasyāntaḥ saṅkhyānaṃ nāpi vidyate(3) /
hetubhūtamaśeṣasya prakṛtiḥ sā parā mune //
120.d:
अनन्तस्य न तस्यान्तः सङ्ख्यानं नापि विद्यते(3) /
हेतुभूतमशेषस्य प्रकृतिः सा परा मुने //
120.m: Since it is infinite, there is neither an end nor a count to it. / It is the causal ground of everything; that, O sage, is supreme nature (prakṛti).

120.s:
asaṅkhyātāni śāṇḍāni tatra jātāni cedṛśāṃ /
dāruṇyagniryathā tailaṃ tile tadvat pumāniti(4) //
120.d:
असङ्ख्यातानि शाण्डानि तत्र जातानि चेदृशां /
दारुण्यग्निर्यथा तैलं तिले तद्वत् पुमानिति(4) //
120.m: Countless eggs like these are born there. / Just as fire is in wood, and oil is in sesame, so is the Spirit (puruṣa).

120.s:
pradhāne ca sthito(5) vyāpī cetanātmātmavedanaḥ /
pradhānañca pumāṃś caiva sarvabhūtātmabhṛtayā(6) //
120.d:
प्रधाने च स्थितो(5) व्यापी चेतनात्मात्मवेदनः /
प्रधानञ्च पुमांश् चैव सर्वभूतात्मभृतया(6) //
120.m: And seated in the primordial matter is the all-pervading conscious Self, knowing itself. / Both primordial matter and Spirit, through the support of the Self of all beings,

120.s:
viṣṇuśaktyā mahāprājña vṛtau saṃśrayadharmiṇau /
tayoḥ(7) saiva pṛthagbhāve kāraṇaṃ saṃśrayasya ca //
:n
1 yatra vai iti ṅa..
2 ayutāni iti ja..
3 saṅkhyānaṃ naiva vidyate iti gha.. , jha.. ca / saṅkhyānaṃ na ca vidyate iti
ga.
4 pumānapi iti gha.. , jha.. ca
5 pradhāne 'vasthitaṃ iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca
6 sarvabhūtānubhūtayā iti ṅa..
7 dvayoriti jha..
:p 27
120.d:
विष्णुशक्त्या महाप्राज्ञ वृतौ संश्रयधर्मिणौ /
तयोः(7) सैव पृथग्भावे कारणं संश्रयस्य च //
:न्
1 यत्र वै इति ङ..
2 अयुतानि इति ज..
3 सङ्ख्यानं नैव विद्यते इति घ.. , झ.. च / सङ्ख्यानं न च विद्यते इति
ग.
4 पुमानपि इति घ.. , झ.. च
5 प्रधाने ऽवस्थितं इति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. च
6 सर्वभूतानुभूतया इति ङ..
7 द्वयोरिति झ..
:प् 27
120.m:
are enveloped by the power of Viṣṇu, O deeply wise one, having the nature of resting upon [it]; / for the two of them, that very [power] is the cause both of separation and of conjunction,
[Footnote]
[Apparatus note:] 1 'yatra vai' in ṅa.
[Apparatus note:] 2 'ayutāni' in ja.
[Apparatus note:] 3 'saṅkhyānaṃ naiva vidyate' in gha. and jha.; 'saṅkhyānaṃ na ca vidyate' in ga.
[Apparatus note:] 4 'pumānapi' in gha. and jha.
[Apparatus note:] 5 'pradhāne 'vasthitaṃ' in kha., ga., and ṅa.
[Apparatus note:] 6 'sarvabhūtānubhūtayā' in ṅa.
[Apparatus note:] 7 'dvayoḥ' in jha.

120.s:
kṣobhakāraṇabhūtaś ca sargakāle mahāmune /
yathā śaityaṃ jale vāto vibharti kaṇikāgataṃ //
120.d:
क्षोभकारणभूतश् च सर्गकाले महामुने /
यथा शैत्यं जले वातो विभर्ति कणिकागतं //
120.m: and it becomes the cause of agitation at the time of creation, O great sage. / Just as the wind bears coolness that has entered water droplets,

120.s:
jagacchaktis tathā viṣṇoḥ pradhānapratipādikāṃ /
viṣṇuśaktiṃ samāsādya devādyāḥ sambhavanti hi //
120.d:
जगच्छक्तिस् तथा विष्णोः प्रधानप्रतिपादिकां /
विष्णुशक्तिं समासाद्य देवाद्याः सम्भवन्ति हि //
120.m: so does the power of Viṣṇu [agitate] the world, making the primordial matter manifest. / Reaching the power of Viṣṇu, gods and other beings come into existence.

120.s:
sa ca viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ brahma yataḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat /
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi bhāskarasya ratho nava //
120.d:
स च विष्णुः स्वयं ब्रह्म यतः सर्वमिदं जगत् /
योजनानां सहस्राणि भास्करस्य रथो नव //
120.m: And that Viṣṇu is himself Brahman, from whom this whole world originates. / The chariot of the sun is nine thousand yojanas [in width].

120.s:
īśādaṇḍastathaivāsya dviguṇo munisattama /
sārdhakoṭis tathā saptaniyutānyadhikāni vai //
120.d:
ईशादण्डस्तथैवास्य द्विगुणो मुनिसत्तम /
सार्धकोटिस् तथा सप्तनियुतान्यधिकानि वै //
120.m: Its pole is twice that measure, O best of sages; / fifteen million and seven hundred thousand more,

120.s:
yojanānāntu tasyākṣastatra cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ /
trinābhimatipañcāraṃ ṣaṇṇemi dvyayanātmakaṃ //
120.d:
योजनानान्तु तस्याक्षस्तत्र चक्रं प्रतिष्ठितं /
त्रिनाभिमतिपञ्चारं षण्णेमि द्व्ययनात्मकं //
120.m: indeed, in yojanas is its axle, and upon it the wheel is fixed. / It has three naves, five spokes, six rims, and embodies the two solstices.

120.s:
saṃvatsaramayaṃ kṛtsnaṃ kālacakraṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ /
catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi dvitīyakṣo vivasvataḥ //
120.d:
संवत्सरमयं कृत्स्नं कालचक्रं प्रतिष्ठितं /
चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि द्वितीयक्षो विवस्वतः //
120.m: The entire wheel of time, consisting of a full year, is fixed upon it. / The second axle of the sun measures forty thousand [yojanas],

120.s:
pañcānyāni tu sārdhāni syandanasya mahāmate /
akṣapramāṇamubhayoḥ pramāṇantadadyugārdhayoḥ //
120.d:
पञ्चान्यानि तु सार्धानि स्यन्दनस्य महामते /
अक्षप्रमाणमुभयोः प्रमाणन्तदद्युगार्धयोः //
120.m: and five and a half more [thousands], O high-minded one, for the chariot. / The measure of both axles corresponds to the measure of the halves of their yokes.

120.s:
hrasvo 'kṣastadyugārdhañca dhruvādhāraṃ rathasya vai /
hayāś ca sapta chandāṃsi gāyatryādīni suvrata //
120.d:
ह्रस्वो ऽक्षस्तद्युगार्धञ्च ध्रुवाधारं रथस्य वै /
हयाश् च सप्त छन्दांसि गायत्र्यादीनि सुव्रत //
120.m: The shorter axle and half the yoke are supported by Dhruva for the chariot; / and the seven horses are the Vedic metres, Gāyatrī and the rest, O faithful observer of vows.

120.s:
udayāstamanaṃ jñeyaṃ darśanādarśanaṃ raveḥ /
yāvanmātrapradeśe tu vaśiṣṭho 'vasthito dhruvaḥ //
120.d:
उदयास्तमनं ज्ञेयं दर्शनादर्शनं रवेः /
यावन्मात्रप्रदेशे तु वशिष्ठो ऽवस्थितो ध्रुवः //
120.m: Sunrise and sunset are understood as the appearance and disappearance of the sun. / In whatever extent of space Dhruva is stationed as fixed,

120.s:
svayamāyāti tāvattu bhūmerābhūtasamplave(1) /
ūrdhottaramṛṣibhyastu dhruvo yatra vyavasthitaḥ //
120.d:
स्वयमायाति तावत्तु भूमेराभूतसम्प्लवे(1) /
ऊर्धोत्तरमृषिभ्यस्तु ध्रुवो यत्र व्यवस्थितः //
120.m: he himself moves as far until the cosmic dissolution of the earth. / Upward and north of the Seven Sages, where Dhruva is positioned,

120.s:
etadviṣṇupadaṃ divyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ vyomni bhāsvaraṃ /
nirdhūtadoṣapaṅkānāṃ yatīnāṃ sthānamuttamaṃ //
:n
1 bhūmerāhūtasamplave iti gha.. , ja.. ca
:p 28
120.d:
एतद्विष्णुपदं दिव्यं तृतीयं व्योम्नि भास्वरं /
निर्धूतदोषपङ्कानां यतीनां स्थानमुत्तमं //
:न्
1 भूमेराहूतसम्प्लवे इति घ.. , ज.. च
:प् 28
120.m:
this is the divine, radiant third step of Viṣṇu in the sky, / the supreme abode of ascetics whose impurities of fault are washed away.
[Footnote]
[Apparatus note:] 1 'bhūmerāhūtasamplave' in gha. and ja.

120.s:
tato gaṅgā prabhavati smaraṇāt pāśanāśanī(1) /
divi rūpaṃ harerjñeyaṃ śiśumārākṛti prabho //
120.d:
ततो गङ्गा प्रभवति स्मरणात् पाशनाशनी(1) /
दिवि रूपं हरेर्ज्ञेयं शिशुमाराकृति प्रभो //
120.m: From there springs the Gaṅgā, destroying worldly bonds upon being remembered. / The celestial form of Hari is known to have the shape of a porpoise (śiśumāra), O lord.

120.s:
sthitaḥ pucche dhruvastatra bhraman bhrāmayati grahān /
sa ratho 'dhiṣṭhitā devair ādityair ṛṣibhirvaraiḥ(2) //
120.d:
स्थितः पुच्छे ध्रुवस्तत्र भ्रमन् भ्रामयति ग्रहान् /
स रथो ऽधिष्ठिता देवैर् आदित्यैर् ऋषिभिर्वरैः(2) //
120.m: Situated at its tail, Dhruva revolves there and causes the planets to revolve. / That chariot is presided over by gods, Ādityas, and eminent sages.

120.s:
gandharvair apsarobhiś ca grāmaṇīsarparākṣasaiḥ(3) /
himoṣṇavārivarṣāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhagavān raviḥ //
120.d:
गन्धर्वैर् अप्सरोभिश् च ग्रामणीसर्पराक्षसैः(3) /
हिमोष्णवारिवर्षाणां कारणं भगवान् रविः //
120.m: along with Gandharvas and Apsarases, chieftains, serpents, and rākṣasas. / The blessed sun is the cause of cold, heat, water, and rain.

120.s:
ṛgvedādimayo viṣṇuḥ sa śubhāśubhakāraṇaṃ /
rathastricakraḥ somasya kundābhāstasya vājinaḥ(4) //
120.d:
ऋग्वेदादिमयो विष्णुः स शुभाशुभकारणं /
रथस्त्रिचक्रः सोमस्य कुन्दाभास्तस्य वाजिनः(4) //
120.m: Viṣṇu consists of the Ṛgveda and the other [Vedas]; he is the cause of good and evil. / The chariot of Soma has three wheels, and his horses are radiant like kunda blossoms.

120.s:
vāmadakṣiṇato yuktā daśa tena caratyasau /
trayastriṃśatsahasrāṇi trayastriṃśacchatāni ca //
120.d:
वामदक्षिणतो युक्ता दश तेन चरत्यसौ /
त्रयस्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि त्रयस्त्रिंशच्छतानि च //
120.m: Yoked on the left and right, they are ten; with it he wanders across [the sky]. / Thirty-three thousand, and thirty-three hundred,

120.s:
trayastriṃśattathā devāḥ pivanti kṣaṇadākaraṃ(5) /
ekāṃ kalāñca pitara ekāmāraśmisaṃsthitāḥ //
120.d:
त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तथा देवाः पिवन्ति क्षणदाकरं(5) /
एकां कलाञ्च पितर एकामारश्मिसंस्थिताः //
120.m: and likewise thirty-three gods drink the maker of the night. / And the ancestors drink one digit, situated in the solar rays.

120.s:
vāyvagnidravyasambhūto rathaś candrasutasya ca /
aṣṭābhisturagair yukto budhastena caratyapi //
120.d:
वाय्वग्निद्रव्यसम्भूतो रथश् चन्द्रसुतस्य च /
अष्टाभिस्तुरगैर् युक्तो बुधस्तेन चरत्यपि //
120.m: The chariot of the son of the Moon (Budha) is born of the substances of wind and fire; / yoked with eight horses, with it Budha also moves.

120.s:
śukrasyāpi ratho 'ṣṭāśvo bhaumasyāpi rathas tathā /
vṛhaspate ratho 'ṣṭāśvaḥ śaneraṣṭāśvako rathaḥ //
120.d:
शुक्रस्यापि रथो ऽष्टाश्वो भौमस्यापि रथस् तथा /
वृहस्पते रथो ऽष्टाश्वः शनेरष्टाश्वको रथः //
120.m: Śukra also has an eight-horse chariot, and Mars likewise has a chariot [of eight horses]. / Bṛhaspati's chariot has eight horses, and Saturn's chariot has eight horses.

120.s:
svarbhānoś ca ratho 'ṣṭāśvaḥ ketoścāṣṭāśvako rathaḥ /
yadadya vaiṣṇavaḥ kāyastato vipra vasundharā //
:n
1 sarvapāpapraṇāśinīti ja..
2 ṛṣabho raveriti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
3 saratha ity ādiḥ, rākṣasair ityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake
nāsti
4 kundābhāstatra vājina iti ka.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
5 kṣaṇadācaramiti jha..
:p 29
120.d:
स्वर्भानोश् च रथो ऽष्टाश्वः केतोश्चाष्टाश्वको रथः /
यदद्य वैष्णवः कायस्ततो विप्र वसुन्धरा //
:न्
1 सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीति ज..
2 ऋषभो रवेरिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. च
3 सरथ इत्य् आदिः, राक्षसैर् इत्यन्तः पाठः झ.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
4 कुन्दाभास्तत्र वाजिन इति क.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
5 क्षणदाचरमिति झ..
:प् 29
120.m:
Svarbhānu (Rāhu) has an eight-horse chariot, and Ketu has an eight-horse chariot. / Since this [whole universe] is the body of Viṣṇu, therefore, O brāhmaṇa, the earth,
[Footnote]
1. "destroyer of all sins" according to ja.
2. "Ṛṣabha of the sun" according to ga., gha., ṅa., and ja.
3. The reading beginning with "sa ratho" and ending with "rākṣasaiḥ" is not found in manuscript jha.
4. "there the horses radiant like kunda blossoms" according to ka., gha., and ṅa.
5. "kṣaṇadācaram" according to jha. / p. 29

120.s:
padmākarā samudbhūtā parvatādyādisaṃyutā /
jyotirbhuvananadyadrisamudravanakaṃ hariḥ //
120.d:
पद्माकरा समुद्भूता पर्वताद्यादिसंयुता /
ज्योतिर्भुवननद्यद्रिसमुद्रवनकं हरिः //
120.m: arisen in the shape of a lotus, endowed with mountains and the rest, / Hari is the luminaries, the worlds, the rivers, the mountains, the oceans, and the forests.

120.s:
yadasti nāsti tadviṣṇurviṣṇujñānavijṛmbhitaṃ(1) /
na vijñānamṛte kiñcij jñānaṃ viṣṇuḥ parampadaṃ //
120.d:
यदस्ति नास्ति तद्विष्णुर्विष्णुज्ञानविजृम्भितं(1) /
न विज्ञानमृते किञ्चिज् ज्ञानं विष्णुः परम्पदं //
120.m: Whatever exists or does not exist, that is Viṣṇu, manifested through the wisdom of Viṣṇu. / There is nothing without specialized knowledge; knowledge is Viṣṇu, the supreme abode.

120.s:
tat kuryād yena viṣṇuḥ syāt satyaṃ jñānamanantakaṃ /
paṭhed bhuvanakoṣaṃ hi yaḥ so 'vāptasukhātmabhāk //
120.d:
तत् कुर्याद् येन विष्णुः स्यात् सत्यं ज्ञानमनन्तकं /
पठेद् भुवनकोषं हि यः सो ऽवाप्तसुखात्मभाक् //
120.m: One should do that whereby Viṣṇu may be [attained], who is truth, knowledge, and boundless. / Whoever indeed reads the "Basket of the Worlds" partakes of self-obtained happiness.

120.s:
jyotiḥśāstrādividhyāś ca śubhāśubhādhipo hariḥ(2) //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe bhuvanakoṣo nāma viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athaikaviṃśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
jyotiḥśāstraṃ
120.d:
ज्योतिःशास्त्रादिविध्याश् च शुभाशुभाधिपो हरिः(2) //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे भुवनकोषो नाम विंशत्यधिकशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथैकविंशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
ज्योतिःशास्त्रं
120.m:
And in the rules of astral science and the rest, Hari is the lord of good and evil.
Thus ends the hundred and twentieth chapter, called "The Basket of the Worlds," in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now, the hundred and twenty-first chapter:
Astral Science

121.s:
agnir uvāca
jyotiḥśāstraṃ pravakṣyāmi śubhāśubhavivekadaṃ /
cāturlakṣasya sāraṃ yat taj jñātvā sarvavidbhavet //
121.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
ज्योतिःशास्त्रं प्रवक्ष्यामि शुभाशुभविवेकदं /
चातुर्लक्षस्य सारं यत् तज् ज्ञात्वा सर्वविद्भवेत् //
121.m: Agni said: / I shall expound astral science, which discerns good and evil, / which is the essence of four hundred thousand [verses], by knowing which one becomes omniscient.

121.s:
ṣaḍaṣṭake(3) vivāho na na ca dvidvādaśe striyāḥ /
na trikoṇe hy atha prītiḥ(4) śeṣe ca samasaptake //
:n
1 jñānavijñānajṛmbhitamiti ja..
2 śubhāśubhāśayo haririti kha.. , cha.. ca
3 ṣaṭkāṣṭake iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
4 na trikoṇeṣu prītiḥ syāditi ja..
:p 30
121.d:
षडष्टके(3) विवाहो न न च द्विद्वादशे स्त्रियाः /
न त्रिकोणे ह्य् अथ प्रीतिः(4) शेषे च समसप्तके //
:न्
1 ज्ञानविज्ञानजृम्भितमिति ज..
2 शुभाशुभाशयो हरिरिति ख.. , छ.. च
3 षट्काष्टके इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. च
4 न त्रिकोणेषु प्रीतिः स्यादिति ज..
:प् 30
121.m:
No marriage [should be made] in the sixth-eighth relation, nor in the second-twelfth for a woman; / indeed, there is no affection in a trine; and in the remaining cases, there is affection in mutual seventh.
[Footnote]
1. "jñānavijñānajṛmbhitam" according to ja.
2. "śubhāśubhāśayo hariḥ" according to kha. and cha.
3. "ṣaṭkāṣṭake" according to kha., ga., gha., ṅa., and ja.
4. "there would be no affection in trines" according to ja. / p. 30

121.s:
dvidvādaśe trikoṇe ca maitrīkṣetrapayoryadi /
bhavedekādhipatyañca tārāprītirathāpi vā //
121.d:
द्विद्वादशे त्रिकोणे च मैत्रीक्षेत्रपयोर्यदि /
भवेदेकाधिपत्यञ्च ताराप्रीतिरथापि वा //
121.m: In the second-twelfth and in the trine, if there is friendship between the lords of the signs, / or if there is common rulership, or also friendliness of nakṣatras,

121.s:
tathāpi kāryaḥ saṃyogo na tu ṣaṭkāṣṭake punaḥ /
jīve bhṛgau cāstamite mriyate ca pumān striyā //
121.d:
तथापि कार्यः संयोगो न तु षट्काष्टके पुनः /
जीवे भृगौ चास्तमिते म्रियते च पुमान् स्त्रिया //
121.m: even then the union may be made, but never in the sixth-eighth. / When Jupiter and Venus have set, the man dies through the woman.

121.s:
gurukṣetragate sūrye sūryakṣetragate gurau /
vivāhaṃ na praśaṃsanti kanyāvaidhavyakṛdbhavet //
121.d:
गुरुक्षेत्रगते सूर्ये सूर्यक्षेत्रगते गुरौ /
विवाहं न प्रशंसन्ति कन्यावैधव्यकृद्भवेत् //
121.m: When the sun is in the sign of Jupiter, or Jupiter is in the sign of the sun, / they do not recommend marriage; it would cause the girl to become a widow.

121.s:
aticāre tripakṣaṃ syādvakre māsacatuṣṭayaṃ /
vratodvāhau na kurvīta gurorvakrāticārayoḥ //
121.d:
अतिचारे त्रिपक्षं स्याद्वक्रे मासचतुष्टयं /
व्रतोद्वाहौ न कुर्वीत गुरोर्वक्रातिचारयोः //
121.m: In accelerated motion it lasts three fortnights, and in retrograde four months; / one should not perform a votive observance or marriage during the retrograde or accelerated motion of Jupiter.

121.s:
caitre pauṣe na riktāsu harau supte kuje ravau /
candrakṣaye cāśubhaṃ syāt sandhyākālaḥ śubhāvahaḥ //
121.d:
चैत्रे पौषे न रिक्तासु हरौ सुप्ते कुजे रवौ /
चन्द्रक्षये चाशुभं स्यात् सन्ध्याकालः शुभावहः //
121.m: In Caitra and Pauṣa, on empty lunar days, when Viṣṇu sleeps, on Tuesday and Sunday, / and at the waning of the moon, it would be inauspicious; twilight time brings auspiciousness.

121.s:
rohiṇī cottarā mūlaṃ svātī hasto 'tha revatī /
tule na mithune śasto vivāhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ //
121.d:
रोहिणी चोत्तरा मूलं स्वाती हस्तो ऽथ रेवती /
तुले न मिथुने शस्तो विवाहः परिकीर्तितः //
121.m: Rohiṇī, the Uttaras, Mūla, Svātī, Hasta, and Revatī; / in Libra and Gemini, marriage is declared to be praiseworthy.

121.s:
vivāhe karṇabedhe ca vrate puṃsavane tathā /
prāśane cādyacūḍāyāṃ biddharkṣañca vivarjayet(1) //
121.d:
विवाहे कर्णबेधे च व्रते पुंसवने तथा /
प्राशने चाद्यचूडायां बिद्धर्क्षञ्च विवर्जयेत्(1) //
121.m: In marriage, in ear-piercing, in a votive observance, likewise in the rite for producing a male child, / in the first feeding, and at the first tonsure, one must avoid an afflicted asterism.

121.s:
śravaṇe mūlapuṣye ca sūryamaṅgalajīvake /
kumbhe siṃhe ca mithune karma puṃsavanaṃ smṛtaṃ //
121.d:
श्रवणे मूलपुष्ये च सूर्यमङ्गलजीवके /
कुम्भे सिंहे च मिथुने कर्म पुंसवनं स्मृतं //
121.m: Under Śravaṇa, Mūla, and Puṣya, on a Sunday, Tuesday, or Thursday, / in Aquarius, Leo, and Gemini, the rite for producing a male child is prescribed.

121.s:
haste mūle mṛge pauṣṇe budhe śukre ca niṣkṛtiḥ /
arkendujīvabhṛguje mūle tāmbūlabhakṣaṇaṃ //
121.d:
हस्ते मूले मृगे पौष्णे बुधे शुक्रे च निष्कृतिः /
अर्केन्दुजीवभृगुजे मूले ताम्बूलभक्षणं //
121.m: Under Hasta, Mūla, Mṛgaśiras, and Pauṣṇa (Revatī), on Wednesday and Friday, taking a child outdoors [is done]; / under Mūla on Sunday, Monday, Thursday, and Friday, the eating of betel [is done].

121.s:
annasya prāśanaṃ śukre jīve mṛge ca maunake(2) /
hastādipañcake puṣpe kṛttikāditraye tathā //
:n
1 viddhamṛkṣaṃ vivarjayet iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
2 jīve makaramīnake iti jha..
:p 31
121.d:
अन्नस्य प्राशनं शुक्रे जीवे मृगे च मौनके(2) /
हस्तादिपञ्चके पुष्पे कृत्तिकादित्रये तथा //
:न्
1 विद्धमृक्षं विवर्जयेत् इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
2 जीवे मकरमीनके इति झ..
:प् 31
121.m:
The first feeding of solid food is on Friday, on Thursday, under Mṛgaśiras, and in Pisces, / in the group of five beginning with Hasta, in Puṣya, and likewise in the triad beginning with Kṛttikā,
[Footnote]
1. "viddhamṛkṣaṃ vivarjayet" according to kha., ga., gha., ṅa., cha., and ja.
2. "in Capricorn and Pisces" according to jha. / p. 31

121.s:
aśvinyāmatha revatyāṃ navānnaphalabhakṣaṇaṃ /
puṣpā hastā tathā jyeṣṭhā rohiṇī śravaṇāśvinau //
121.d:
अश्विन्यामथ रेवत्यां नवान्नफलभक्षणं /
पुष्पा हस्ता तथा ज्येष्ठा रोहिणी श्रवणाश्विनौ //
121.m: under Aśvinī, and under Revatī; [and under these asterisms is] the eating of new grain and fruits. / Puṣya, Hasta, Jyeṣṭhā, Rohiṇī, Śravaṇa, and Aśvinī,

121.s:
svātisaumye ca bhaiṣajyaṃ kuryādanyatra varjayet /
pūrvātrayaṃ(1) maghā yāmyaṃ pāvanaṃ(2) śravaṇatrayaṃ //
121.d:
स्वातिसौम्ये च भैषज्यं कुर्यादन्यत्र वर्जयेत् /
पूर्वात्रयं(1) मघा याम्यं पावनं(2) श्रवणत्रयं //
121.m: and under Svātī and Mṛgaśiras, one should administer medicine; elsewhere one should avoid it. / The triad of the Pūrvās, Maghā, Bharaṇī, Svātī, and the triad of Śravaṇa—

121.s:
bhaumādityaśanervāre snātavyaṃ rogamuktitaḥ /
pārthive cāṣṭahrīṃkāraṃ madhye nāma ca dikṣu ca //
121.d:
भौमादित्यशनेर्वारे स्नातव्यं रोगमुक्तितः /
पार्थिवे चाष्टह्रींकारं मध्ये नाम च दिक्षु च //
121.m: on Tuesday, Sunday, and Saturday, a bath should be taken for freedom from disease. / On an earthen [diagram], [inscribe] eight syllables Hrīṃ, and in the middle write the name, and in the cardinal directions:

121.s:
hrīṃ puṭaṃ pārthive dikṣu hrīṃ vidikṣu likhedvasūn /
gorocanākuṅkumena bhūrje vastre gale dhṛtaṃ //
121.d:
ह्रीं पुटं पार्थिवे दिक्षु ह्रीं विदिक्षु लिखेद्वसून् /
गोरोचनाकुङ्कुमेन भूर्जे वस्त्रे गले धृतं //
121.m: an enclosure of Hrīṃ on the earthen [diagram] in the cardinal directions, and write the eight Vasus [or eight Hrīṃs] in the intermediate directions, / with yellow orpiment and saffron on birch-bark or cloth, worn on the neck,

121.s:
śatravo vaśamāyānti mantreṇānena niścitaṃ /
śrīṃ hrīṃ sampuṭaṃ nāma śrīṃ hrīṃ patrāṣṭakekramāt //
121.d:
शत्रवो वशमायान्ति मन्त्रेणानेन निश्चितं /
श्रीं ह्रीं सम्पुटं नाम श्रीं ह्रीं पत्राष्टकेक्रमात् //
121.m: enemies are brought into subjection by this mantra, undoubtedly. / Enclosing the name with Śrīṃ and Hrīṃ, [writing] Śrīṃ and Hrīṃ on the eight petals in order,

121.s:
gorocanākuṅkumena bhurje 'tha subhagāvṛte /
gomadhyavāgamaḥ patre haridrāyā rasena ca //
121.d:
गोरोचनाकुङ्कुमेन भुर्जे ऽथ सुभगावृते /
गोमध्यवागमः पत्रे हरिद्राया रसेन च //
121.m: with yellow orpiment and saffron on birch-bark, surrounded by auspicious marks, / [...] on a leaf with the juice of turmeric,

121.s:
śilāpaṭṭe 'rīn stambhayati bhūmāvadhomukhīkṛṭaṃ /
oṃ hūṃ saḥ(3) sampuṭannāma oṃ hūṃ saḥ(4) patrāṣṭakekramāt //
121.d:
शिलापट्टे ऽरीन् स्तम्भयति भूमावधोमुखीकृटं /
ओं हूं सः(3) सम्पुटन्नाम ओं हूं सः(4) पत्राष्टकेक्रमात् //
121.m: placed face downwards on a stone slab on the ground, it paralyzes enemies. / Enclosing the name with Oṃ Hūṃ Saḥ, [and placing] Oṃ Hūṃ Saḥ on the eight petals in order,

121.s:
gorocanākuṅkumena bhūrje mṛtyunivāraṇaṃ /
ekapañcanavaprītyai(5) dviṣatdvādaśayogakāḥ //
121.d:
गोरोचनाकुङ्कुमेन भूर्जे मृत्युनिवारणं /
एकपञ्चनवप्रीत्यै(5) द्विषत्द्वादशयोगकाः //
121.m: with yellow orpiment and saffron on birch-bark, [this brings] warding off of death. / For affection [are the positions] one, five, and nine; combinations of two, six, and twelve [are unfavourable];

121.s:
trisaptaikādaśe lābho vedāṣṭadvādaśe ripuḥ /
tanurdhanañca sahajaḥ suhṛt suto ripus tathā //
121.d:
त्रिसप्तैकादशे लाभो वेदाष्टद्वादशे रिपुः /
तनुर्धनञ्च सहजः सुहृत् सुतो रिपुस् तथा //
121.m: in three, seven, and eleven there is gain; in four, eight, and twelve is the enemy. / The body, wealth, siblings, friends, children, and enemies,

121.s:
jāyā nidhanadharmau ca karmāyavyayakaṃ kramāt /
:n
1 pūrvātrikamiti ja..
2 pāvakamiti ṅa..
3 oṃ hraṃ sa iti cha..
4 oṃ jūṃ sa iti kha.. / oṃ hraṃ sa iti cha..
5 ekapañcanavaśāntyai iti ja..
:p 32
sphuṭaṃ mesādilagneṣu navatārābalaṃ vadet //
121.d:
जाया निधनधर्मौ च कर्मायव्ययकं क्रमात् /
:न्
1 पूर्वात्रिकमिति ज..
2 पावकमिति ङ..
3 ओं ह्रं स इति छ..
4 ओं जूं स इति ख.. / ओं ह्रं स इति छ..
5 एकपञ्चनवशान्त्यै इति ज..
:प् 32
स्फुटं मेसादिलग्नेषु नवताराबलं वदेत् //
121.m:
the spouse, death, and virtue, action, income, and expenditure, in order,
[Footnote]
1. "pūrvātrikam" according to ja.
2. "pāvakam" according to ṅa.
3. "oṃ hraṃ saḥ" according to cha.
4. "oṃ jūṃ saḥ" according to kha.; "oṃ hraṃ saḥ" according to cha.
5. "for the pacification of one, five, and nine" according to ja. / p. 32
one should clearly state the strength of the nine asterisms in the ascendants beginning with Aries.

121.s:
janma sampadvipat kṣemaṃ pratyariḥ sādhakaḥ kramāt /
nidhanaṃ mitrapramamitraṃ tārābalaṃ viduḥ //
121.d:
जन्म सम्पद्विपत् क्षेमं प्रत्यरिः साधकः क्रमात् /
निधनं मित्रप्रममित्रं ताराबलं विदुः //
121.m: Birth, prosperity, adversity, welfare, enemy, achiever in order, / destruction, friend, and supreme friend: they recognize this as the strength of the asterisms.

121.s:
dhāre jñaguruśukrāṇāṃ sūryācandramasos tathā /
māghādimasāṣaṭke tu kṣīramādyaṃ praśasyate //
121.d:
धारे ज्ञगुरुशुक्राणां सूर्याचन्द्रमसोस् तथा /
माघादिमसाषट्के तु क्षीरमाद्यं प्रशस्यते //
121.m: On the weekdays of Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus, and likewise of the Sun and Moon, / during the six months beginning with Māgha, the first milk is praised.

121.s:
karṇabedho budhe jīve puṣye śravaṇacitrayoḥ /
pañcame 'bde cādhyayanaṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ pratipadantyajet //
121.d:
कर्णबेधो बुधे जीवे पुष्ये श्रवणचित्रयोः /
पञ्चमे ऽब्दे चाध्ययनं षष्ठीं प्रतिपदन्त्यजेत् //
121.m: Ear-piercing [is recommended] on a Wednesday or Thursday, under Puṣya, Śravaṇa, or Citrā. / And study [should begin] in the fifth year; one should avoid the sixth and the first lunar day.

121.s:
riktāṃ pañcadaśīṃ bhaumaṃ prārcya vāṇīṃ hariṃ śriyaṃ /
māghādimāsaṣatke tu(1) makhalābandhanaṃ śubhaṃ //
121.d:
रिक्तां पञ्चदशीं भौमं प्रार्च्य वाणीं हरिं श्रियं /
माघादिमासषत्के तु(1) मखलाबन्धनं शुभं //
121.m: Having first worshipped Vāṇī, Hari, and Śrī on empty [tithis], the fifteenth, and Tuesday, / the tying of the girdle [for investiture] is auspicious during the six months starting with Māgha.

121.s:
cūḍākaraṇakādyañca śravaṇādau na śasyate /
astaṃ yāte guro śukre kṣīṇe ca śaśalāñchane //
121.d:
चूडाकरणकाद्यञ्च श्रवणादौ न शस्यते /
अस्तं याते गुरो शुक्रे क्षीणे च शशलाञ्छने //
121.m: The tonsure rite and other [ceremonies] are not commended under Śravaṇa and similar [asterisms], / nor when Jupiter or Venus has set, or when the moon is waning.

121.s:
upanītasya viprasya mṛtyuṃ jāḍyaṃ vinirdiśet /
kṣaurarkṣe śubhavāre ca samāvartanamiṣyate //
121.d:
उपनीतस्य विप्रस्य मृत्युं जाड्यं विनिर्दिशेत् /
क्षौरर्क्षे शुभवारे च समावर्तनमिष्यते //
121.m: For an initiated Brahmin, one should predict death and dullness [if done then]. / The formal return home from study is desired under an asterism fit for tonsure and on an auspicious weekday,

121.s:
śubhakṣetre vilagneṣu śubhayuktekṣiteṣu ca /
aśvinīmaghācitrāsu svātīyāmyottarāsu ca //
121.d:
शुभक्षेत्रे विलग्नेषु शुभयुक्तेक्षितेषु च /
अश्विनीमघाचित्रासु स्वातीयाम्योत्तरासु च //
121.m: in auspicious zodiacal signs, with ascendants joined or aspected by benefics, / and under Aśvinī, Maghā, Citrā, Svātī, Yāmya, or the Uttarā asterisms.

121.s:
punarvasau tathā puṣye dhanurvedaḥ praśasyate /
bharaṇyārdrā maghāśleṣā vahnibhagarkṣayos tathā //
121.d:
पुनर्वसौ तथा पुष्ये धनुर्वेदः प्रशस्यते /
भरण्यार्द्रा मघाश्लेषा वह्निभगर्क्षयोस् तथा //
121.m: Under Punarvasu and Puṣya, [the study of] the science of archery is praised. / Under Bharaṇī, Ārdrā, Maghā, Āśleṣā, and under the asterisms of Fire and Bhaga,

121.s:
jijīviṣur na kurvīta vastraprāvaraṇaṃ naraḥ /
gurau śukre budhe vastraṃ vivāhādau na bhādikaṃ //
121.d:
जिजीविषुर् न कुर्वीत वस्त्रप्रावरणं नरः /
गुरौ शुक्रे बुधे वस्त्रं विवाहादौ न भादिकं //
121.m: a man desiring to live long should not put on a [new] garment. / On Thursday, Friday, and Wednesday, [new] clothing [is worn]; at marriages and similar occasions, [inauspicious] asterisms and the like are not [prohibited].

121.s:
revatyaśvidhaniṣṭhāsu hastādiṣu ca pañcasu /
śaṅkhavidrumaratnānāṃ paridhānaṃ praśasyate //
:n
1 māghādimāsaṣaṭkeṣu iti jha .
:p 33
121.d:
रेवत्यश्विधनिष्ठासु हस्तादिषु च पञ्चसु /
शङ्खविद्रुमरत्नानां परिधानं प्रशस्यते //
:न्
1 माघादिमासषट्केषु इति झ .
:प् 33
121.m:
Under Revatī, Aśvinī, Dhaniṣṭhā, and the five asterisms beginning with Hasta, / the wearing of conch, coral, and gems is commended.
[Footnote]
1. 'In the six months beginning with Māgha' thus in manuscript jha. / [Page 33]

121.s:
yāmyasarpadhaniṣṭhāsu(1) triṣu pūrveṣu vāruṇe(2) /
krītaṃ hānikaraṃ dravyaṃ vikrītaṃ lābhakṛdbhavet //
121.d:
याम्यसर्पधनिष्ठासु(1) त्रिषु पूर्वेषु वारुणे(2) /
क्रीतं हानिकरं द्रव्यं विक्रीतं लाभकृद्भवेत् //
121.m: Under the asterism of Yama, the Serpent, and Dhaniṣṭhā, under the three Pūrva asterisms, and under Vāruṇa, / goods purchased bring loss, whereas those sold produce profit.

121.s:
aśvinīsvāticitrāsu revatyāṃ vāruṇe harau /
krītaṃ lābhakaraṃ dravayaṃ vikrītaṃ hānikṛdbhavet //
121.d:
अश्विनीस्वातिचित्रासु रेवत्यां वारुणे हरौ /
क्रीतं लाभकरं द्रवयं विक्रीतं हानिकृद्भवेत् //
121.m: Under Aśvinī, Svātī, Citrā, Revatī, Vāruṇa, and Hari, / goods purchased bring profit, whereas those sold produce loss.

121.s:
bharaṇī trīṇi pūrvāṇi ārdrāśleṣā maghānilāḥ /
vahnijyeṣṭāviśākhāsu svāmino nopatiṣṭhate //
121.d:
भरणी त्रीणि पूर्वाणि आर्द्राश्लेषा मघानिलाः /
वह्निज्येष्टाविशाखासु स्वामिनो नोपतिष्ठते //
121.m: Under Bharaṇī, the three Pūrvā asterisms, Ārdrā, Āśleṣā, Maghā, the Wind asterism, / the Fire asterism, Jyeṣṭhā, and Viśākhā, [goods] do not remain with their master.

121.s:
dravyaṃ dattaṃ prayuktaṃ vā yatra nikṣipyate dhanaṃ /
uttare śravaṇe śākre kuryādrājābhiṣecanaṃ //
121.d:
द्रव्यं दत्तं प्रयुक्तं वा यत्र निक्षिप्यते धनं /
उत्तरे श्रवणे शाक्रे कुर्याद्राजाभिषेचनं //
121.m: When wealth is given, loaned, or deposited [under these, it is lost]. / Under Uttarā, Śravaṇa, and Indra's asterism, one should perform the royal consecration.

121.s:
caitraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ tathā bhādramāśvinaṃ pauṣameva ca /
māghaṃ caiva parityajya śeṣamāse gṛhaṃ śubhaṃ //
121.d:
चैत्रं ज्येष्ठं तथा भाद्रमाश्विनं पौषमेव च /
माघं चैव परित्यज्य शेषमासे गृहं शुभं //
121.m: Avoiding Caitra, Jyeṣṭha, Bhādra, Āśvina, Pauṣa, / and Māgha, building a house is auspicious in the remaining months.

121.s:
aśvinī rohiṇī mūlamuttarātrayamaindavaṃ /
svātī hastānurādhā ca gṛhārambhe praśasyate //
121.d:
अश्विनी रोहिणी मूलमुत्तरात्रयमैन्दवं /
स्वाती हस्तानुराधा च गृहारम्भे प्रशस्यते //
121.m: Aśvinī, Rohiṇī, Mūla, the three Uttarā asterisms, the moon's asterism, / Svātī, Hasta, and Anurādhā are praised for commencing a house.

121.s:
ādityabhaumavarjantu vāpīprāsādake tathā /
siṃharāśigate jīve gurvāditye malimluce //
121.d:
आदित्यभौमवर्जन्तु वापीप्रासादके तथा /
सिंहराशिगते जीवे गुर्वादित्ये मलिम्लुचे //
121.m: Excepting Sunday and Tuesday, [it is auspicious] also for a reservoir and a temple. / When Jupiter is in Leo, when Jupiter and the Sun are in conjunction, during an intercalary month,

121.s:
bāle vṛddhe 'stage śukre gṛhakarma vivarjayet /
agnidāho bhayaṃ rogo rājapīḍā dhanakṣatiḥ //
121.d:
बाले वृद्धे ऽस्तगे शुक्रे गृहकर्म विवर्जयेत् /
अग्निदाहो भयं रोगो राजपीडा धनक्षतिः //
121.m: or when Venus is infant, aged, or set, one should avoid house-building work: / [otherwise there will be] burning by fire, fear, disease, oppression by the king, and loss of wealth.

121.s:
saṅgrahe tṛṇakāṣṭhānāṃ kṛte śravaṇapañcake /
gṛhapraveśanaṃ kuryāddhaniṣṭhottaravāruṇe //
121.d:
सङ्ग्रहे तृणकाष्ठानां कृते श्रवणपञ्चके /
गृहप्रवेशनं कुर्याद्धनिष्ठोत्तरवारुणे //
121.m: If the collecting of thatch and wood is done during the five asterisms beginning with Śravaṇa, / one should perform house-entering under Dhaniṣṭhā, Uttarā, or Vāruṇa.

121.s:
naukāyā ghaṭane dvitripañcasaptatrayodaśī /
nṛpadarśī dhaniṣṭhāsu hastāpauṣṇāśvinīṣu ca //
121.d:
नौकाया घटने द्वित्रिपञ्चसप्तत्रयोदशी /
नृपदर्शी धनिष्ठासु हस्तापौष्णाश्विनीषु च //
121.m: For building a boat, the second, third, fifth, seventh, and thirteenth lunar days [are fit]. / One visits the king under Dhaniṣṭhā, Hasta, Revatī, and Aśvinī.

121.s:
pūrvātrayandhaniṣṭhārdrā vahniḥ saumyaviśākhayoḥ /
:n
1 yāmyasarpaviśākhāsu iti gha.. , ja.. ca
2 pūrveṣu cānale iti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
:p 34
aśleṣā cāśvinī caiva yātrāsiddhistu sampadā(1) //
121.d:
पूर्वात्रयन्धनिष्ठार्द्रा वह्निः सौम्यविशाखयोः /
:न्
1 याम्यसर्पविशाखासु इति घ.. , ज.. च
2 पूर्वेषु चानले इति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
:प् 34
अश्लेषा चाश्विनी चैव यात्रासिद्धिस्तु सम्पदा(1) //
121.m:
Under the three Pūrvā asterisms, Dhaniṣṭhā, Ārdrā, the Fire asterism, the asterism of the Moon, and Viśākhā,
[Footnote]
1. 'Under the asterism of Yama, the Serpent, and Viśākhā' thus in manuscripts gha and ja.
2. 'Under the Pūrvā asterisms and Anala' thus in manuscripts ga, gha, and ṅa. / [Page 34]
as well as Āśleṣā and Aśvinī, success in a journey [is attained] along with prosperity.

121.s:
triṣūttareṣu rohiṇyāṃ sinībālī caturdaśī /
śravaṇā caiva hastā ca citrā ca vaiṣṇavī tathā //
121.d:
त्रिषूत्तरेषु रोहिण्यां सिनीबाली चतुर्दशी /
श्रवणा चैव हस्ता च चित्रा च वैष्णवी तथा //
121.m: Under the three Uttarā asterisms, Rohiṇī, on the new moon day, on the fourteenth, / under Śravaṇa, Hasta, Citrā, and the asterism of Viṣṇu,

121.s:
goṣṭhayātrāṃ na kurvīta praveśaṃ naiva kārayet /
anilottararohiṇyāṃ mṛgamūlapunarvasau //
121.d:
गोष्ठयात्रां न कुर्वीत प्रवेशं नैव कारयेत् /
अनिलोत्तररोहिण्यां मृगमूलपुनर्वसौ //
121.m: one should not make a journey to the cow-pen, nor should one make [the cattle] enter it. / Under the Wind asterism, the Uttarā asterisms, Rohiṇī, Mṛga, Mūla, and Punarvasu,

121.s:
puṣyaśravaṇahasteṣu kṛṣikarma samācaret(2) /
punarvasūttarāsvātībhagamūlendravāruṇe(3) //
121.d:
पुष्यश्रवणहस्तेषु कृषिकर्म समाचरेत्(2) /
पुनर्वसूत्तरास्वातीभगमूलेन्द्रवारुणे(3) //
121.m: and under Puṣya, Śravaṇa, and Hasta, one should carry out agricultural work. / Under Punarvasu, Uttarā, Svātī, the asterism of Bhaga, Mūla, Indra, and Varuṇa,

121.s:
guroḥ śukrasya vāre vā vāre ca(4) somabhāsvatoḥ /
vṛṣalagne ca kartavyaṅkanyāyāṃ mithune tathā //
121.d:
गुरोः शुक्रस्य वारे वा वारे च(4) सोमभास्वतोः /
वृषलग्ने च कर्तव्यङ्कन्यायां मिथुने तथा //
121.m: on the weekday of Jupiter or Venus, or on the day of the Moon or the Sun, / and in the Taurus ascendant, as also in Virgo or Gemini,

121.s:
dvipañca(5) daśamī sapta tṛtīyā ca trayodaśī /
revatīrohiṇīndrāgnihastamaitrottareṣu(6) ca //
121.d:
द्विपञ्च(5) दशमी सप्त तृतीया च त्रयोदशी /
रेवतीरोहिणीन्द्राग्निहस्तमैत्रोत्तरेषु(6) च //
121.m: on the second, fifth, tenth, seventh, third, and thirteenth lunar days, / and under Revatī, Rohiṇī, the asterism of Indra and Agni, Hasta, Mitra's asterism, and the Uttarā asterisms,

121.s:
mandāravarjaṃ vījāni vāpayet sampadarthyapi(7) /
revatīhastamūleṣu śravaṇe bhagamaitrayoḥ //
121.d:
मन्दारवर्जं वीजानि वापयेत् सम्पदर्थ्यपि(7) /
रेवतीहस्तमूलेषु श्रवणे भगमैत्रयोः //
121.m: except on Saturday and Tuesday, one seeking prosperity should sow seeds. / Under Revatī, Hasta, Mūla, Śravaṇa, and the asterisms of Bhaga and Mitra,

121.s:
pitṛdaive tathā saumye dhānyacchedaṃ mṛgodaye /
hastacitrāditisvātau revatyāṃ śravaṇatraye //
121.d:
पितृदैवे तथा सौम्ये धान्यच्छेदं मृगोदये /
हस्तचित्रादितिस्वातौ रेवत्यां श्रवणत्रये //
121.m: under the asterism of the Ancestors and that of the Moon, harvesting of grain [is done] at the rising of Capricorn. / Under Hasta, Citrā, the asterism of Aditi, Svātī, Revatī, and the three Śravaṇa asterisms,

121.s:
sthire lagne(8) gurorvāre atha(9) bhārgavasaumyayoḥ /
yāmyāditimaghājyeṣṭhāsūtareṣu praveśayet //
:n
1 yātrāsiddhiṣu sampada iti ga.. , ja.. ca
2 samārabhediti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
3 bhagamūle ca vāruṇe iti kha.. , cha.. ca
4 vāre vā iti ja..
5 tripañceti ja..
6 hastamaitrottarāsu iti ja..
7 vāpayet saṃyato 'pi ceti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
8 care lagne iti jha..
9 gurorvārethavā iti gha.. , ja.. ca
:p 35
oṃ dhanadāya(1) sarvadhaneśāya dehi me dhanaṃ svāhā(2) / oṃ nave
varṣe ilādevi lokasaṃvardhani kāmarūpiṇi dehi me dhanaṃ svāhā
||
121.d:
स्थिरे लग्ने(8) गुरोर्वारे अथ(9) भार्गवसौम्ययोः /
याम्यादितिमघाज्येष्ठासूतरेषु प्रवेशयेत् //
:न्
1 यात्रासिद्धिषु सम्पद इति ग.. , ज.. च
2 समारभेदिति घ.. , ङ.. च
3 भगमूले च वारुणे इति ख.. , छ.. च
4 वारे वा इति ज..
5 त्रिपञ्चेति ज..
6 हस्तमैत्रोत्तरासु इति ज..
7 वापयेत् संयतो ऽपि चेति ख.. , छ.. , ज.. च
8 चरे लग्ने इति झ..
9 गुरोर्वारेथवा इति घ.. , ज.. च
:प् 35
ओं धनदाय(1) सर्वधनेशाय देहि मे धनं स्वाहा(2) / ओं नवे
वर्षे इलादेवि लोकसंवर्धनि कामरूपिणि देहि मे धनं स्वाहा
||
121.m:
in a fixed ascendant, on Thursday, Friday, or Wednesday, / [or] under the asterisms of Yama, Aditi, Maghā, Jyeṣṭhā, and the Uttarā asterisms, one should store [grain].
[Footnote]
1. 'With prosperity in undertakings of journeys' thus in manuscripts ga and ja.
2. 'One should commence' thus in manuscripts gha and ṅa.
3. 'Under the asterism of Bhaga, Mūla, and Vāruṇa' thus in manuscripts kha and cha.
4. 'Or on the day' thus in manuscript ja.
5. 'Third and fifth' thus in manuscript ja.
6. 'Under Hasta, Mitra's asterism, and the Uttarā asterisms' thus in manuscript ja.
7. 'One self-controlled should sow' thus in manuscripts kha, cha, and ja.
8. 'In a movable ascendant' thus in manuscript jha.
9. 'On Thursday or else' thus in manuscripts gha and ja. / [Page 35]
"Oṃ, to the Bestower of Wealth, the Lord of all wealth: give me wealth, svāhā! Oṃ, in the new year, O Goddess Ilā, promoter of the worlds, assuming forms at will: give me wealth, svāhā!"

121.s:
patrasthaṃ likhitaṃ dhānyarāśisthaṃ dhānyavardhanaṃ /
tripūrvāsu viśākhāyāṃ dhaniṣṭhāvāruṇe 'pi ca //
121.d:
पत्रस्थं लिखितं धान्यराशिस्थं धान्यवर्धनं /
त्रिपूर्वासु विशाखायां धनिष्ठावारुणे ऽपि च //
121.m: Written on a leaf and placed upon a heap of grain, this increases the grain. / Under the three Pūrvā asterisms, Viśākhā, Dhaniṣṭhā, and Vāruṇa,

121.s:
eteṣu ṣaṭsu vijñeyaṃ dhānyaniṣkramaṇaṃ budhaiḥ /
devatārāmavāpyādipratiṣṭhodaṅmukhe ravau //
121.d:
एतेषु षट्सु विज्ञेयं धान्यनिष्क्रमणं बुधैः /
देवतारामवाप्यादिप्रतिष्ठोदङ्मुखे रवौ //
121.m: under these six asterisms the wise understand that the removal of grain [should occur]. / Consecration of deities, groves, reservoirs, and the like [should be done] when the Sun is facing north.

121.s:
mithunasthe ravau darśādyādi syād dvādaśī tithiḥ /
sadā tatraiva kartavyaṃ śayanaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ //
121.d:
मिथुनस्थे रवौ दर्शाद्यादि स्याद् द्वादशी तिथिः /
सदा तत्रैव कर्तव्यं शयनं चक्रपाणिनः //
121.m: When the Sun is in Gemini, from the new moon day, if there be the twelfth lunar day, / the ritual slumber of the discus-wielder should always be performed then.

121.s:
siṃhatauliṅgate(3) cārke darśādyadvādaśīdvayaṃ /
ādāvindrasamuptyānaṃ prabodhaś ca hareḥ kramāt //
121.d:
सिंहतौलिङ्गते(3) चार्के दर्शाद्यद्वादशीद्वयं /
आदाविन्द्रसमुप्त्यानं प्रबोधश् च हरेः क्रमात् //
121.m: When the Sun has entered Leo and Libra, on the two twelfth lunar days following the new moon, / there occur respectively the raising of Indra's banner and the awakening of Hari.

121.s:
tathā kanyāgate bhānau(4) durgoptyāne tathāṣṭamī /
tripādeṣu ca ṛkṣeṣu yadā bhadrā tithirbhavet //
121.d:
तथा कन्यागते भानौ(4) दुर्गोप्त्याने तथाष्टमी /
त्रिपादेषु च ऋक्षेषु यदा भद्रा तिथिर्भवेत् //
121.m: Likewise, when the Sun has entered Virgo, on the eighth lunar day occurs the raising of Durgā's [flag]. / When a Bhadrā lunar day falls under three-quartered asterisms,

121.s:
bhaumādityaśanaiścāri vijñeyaṃ tat tripuṣkaraṃ /
sarvakarmaṇyupādeyā viśuddhiś candratarayoḥ(5) //
121.d:
भौमादित्यशनैश्चारि विज्ञेयं तत् त्रिपुष्करं /
सर्वकर्मण्युपादेया विशुद्धिश् चन्द्रतरयोः(5) //
121.m: on a Tuesday, Sunday, or Saturday, that is to be known as Tripuṣkara. / In all rituals, purity of the Moon and the stars must be sought.

121.s:
janmāśritastriṣaṣṭhaś ca saptamo daśamas tathā /
ekādaśaḥ śaśī yeṣānteṣāmeva śubhaṃ vadet //
121.d:
जन्माश्रितस्त्रिषष्ठश् च सप्तमो दशमस् तथा /
एकादशः शशी येषान्तेषामेव शुभं वदेत् //
121.m: For those whose moon occupies the birth sign, the third, the sixth, the seventh, the tenth, / or the eleventh house, one should declare it auspicious alone.

121.s:
śuklapakṣe dvītīyaś ca pañcamo navamaḥ śubhaḥ /
mitrātimitrasādhakasapatkṣemāditārakāḥ //
:n
1 oṃ śrīṃ dhanadāyeti ja..
2 ``nave varṣe gurorvāre atha bhārgavasaumyayoḥ'' eṣa pāṭhotra cha..
pustakedhiko 'sti
3 siṃhatauligate iti kha..
4 kanyārāśigate bhānau iti gha..
5 viśuddhiś candrasūryayoriti ja..
:p 36
121.d:
शुक्लपक्षे द्वीतीयश् च पञ्चमो नवमः शुभः /
मित्रातिमित्रसाधकसपत्क्षेमादितारकाः //
:न्
1 ओं श्रीं धनदायेति ज..
2 ``नवे वर्षे गुरोर्वारे अथ भार्गवसौम्ययोः'' एष पाठोत्र छ..
पुस्तकेधिको ऽस्ति
3 सिंहतौलिगते इति ख..
4 कन्याराशिगते भानौ इति घ..
5 विशुद्धिश् चन्द्रसूर्ययोरिति ज..
:प् 36
121.m:
In the bright fortnight, the second, fifth, and ninth are auspicious. / The friendly, intimate friend, accomplishing, prosperous, and secure stars,
[Footnote]
1. 'Oṃ śrīṃ, to the Bestower of Wealth' thus in manuscript ja.
2. "In the new year, on Thursday, or Friday, or Wednesday"—this reading is found additionally in manuscript cha.
3. 'Entered Leo and Libra' thus in manuscript kha.
4. 'When the Sun has entered the sign of Virgo' thus in manuscript gha.
5. 'Purity of the Moon and the Sun' thus in manuscript ja. / [Page 36]

121.s:
janmanā mṛtyumāpnoti vipadā dhanasaṅkṣayaṃ /
pratyarau maraṇaṃ vidyānnidhane yāti pañcatāṃ //
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīdinādūrdhvaṃ
121.d:
जन्मना मृत्युमाप्नोति विपदा धनसङ्क्षयं /
प्रत्यरौ मरणं विद्यान्निधने याति पञ्चतां //
कृष्णाष्टमीदिनादूर्ध्वं
121.m:
produce death under the birth star, loss of wealth under the danger star; / one should know that under the adversary star comes death, and under the destruction star one meets dissolution.
Beyond the day of the eighth lunar day of the dark fortnight,

121.s:
yāvacchuklāṣṭamīdinaṃ(1) /
tāvat kālaṃ śaśī kṣīṇaḥ pūrṇastatropari smṛtaḥ //
121.d:
यावच्छुक्लाष्टमीदिनं(1) /
तावत् कालं शशी क्षीणः पूर्णस्तत्रोपरि स्मृतः //
121.m:
until the day of the eighth lunar day of the bright fortnight,
for that long the moon is waned; thereafter it is considered full.

121.s:
vṛṣe ca mithune bhānau jīve candrendradaivate(2) /
paurṇamāsī gurorvāre mahājyauṣṭhī prakīrtitā //
121.d:
वृषे च मिथुने भानौ जीवे चन्द्रेन्द्रदैवते(2) /
पौर्णमासी गुरोर्वारे महाज्यौष्ठी प्रकीर्तिता //
121.m:
When the sun is in Taurus or Gemini, and Jupiter is in the constellation ruled by the Moon or Indra,
a full-moon day on the weekday of Jupiter is proclaimed as the Mahājyaiṣṭhī.

121.s:
aindre guruḥ śaśī caiva prājāpatye ravis tathā /
pūrṇimā jyeṣṭhamāsasya mahājyauṣṭhī prakīrtitā //
121.d:
ऐन्द्रे गुरुः शशी चैव प्राजापत्ये रविस् तथा /
पूर्णिमा ज्येष्ठमासस्य महाज्यौष्ठी प्रकीर्तिता //
121.m:
When Jupiter is in the lunar mansion of Indra, the Moon likewise, and the Sun in that of Prajāpati,
the full moon of the month of Jyeṣṭha is proclaimed as the Mahājyaiṣṭhī.

121.s:
svātyantare yantraniṣṭhe śakrasyotthāpayed dhvajaṃ /
haryṛkṣapāde(3) cāśvinyāṃ saptāhānte visarjayet //
121.d:
स्वात्यन्तरे यन्त्रनिष्ठे शक्रस्योत्थापयेद् ध्वजं /
हर्यृक्षपादे(3) चाश्विन्यां सप्ताहान्ते विसर्जयेत् //
121.m:
Within Svātī, placed on a machine, one should raise Indra's banner;
and in a quarter of the lunar mansion of Viṣṇu, under Aśvinī, at the end of seven days, one should discharge it.

121.s:
sarvaṃ hemasamandānaṃ sarve brahmasamā dvijāḥ /
sarvaṃ gaṅgāsamantoyaṃ rāhugraste divākare //
121.d:
सर्वं हेमसमन्दानं सर्वे ब्रह्मसमा द्विजाः /
सर्वं गङ्गासमन्तोयं राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे //
121.m:
Every gift is equal to gold, all twice-born are equal to Brahmā,
all water is equal to the Gaṅgā, when the sun is eclipsed by Rāhu.

121.s:
dhvāṅkṣī mahodarī ghorā mandā mandākinī dvijāḥ(4) /
rākṣasī ca krameṇārkātsaṅkrāntirnāmabhiḥ smṛtā //
121.d:
ध्वाङ्क्षी महोदरी घोरा मन्दा मन्दाकिनी द्विजाः(4) /
राक्षसी च क्रमेणार्कात्सङ्क्रान्तिर्नामभिः स्मृता //
121.m:
Dhvāṅkṣī, Mahodarī, Ghorā, Mandā, Mandākinī, O twice-born,
and Rākṣasī: in order from Sunday, the solar ingress is known by these names.

121.s:
bālave kaulave nāge taitile karaṇe yadi /
uttiṣṭhan saṅkramatyarkrastadā lokaḥ(5) sukhī bhavet //
121.d:
बालवे कौलवे नागे तैतिले करणे यदि /
उत्तिष्ठन् सङ्क्रमत्यर्क्रस्तदा लोकः(5) सुखी भवेत् //
121.m:
If the sun ingresses while standing in the karaṇas Bālava, Kaulava, Nāga, or Taitila,
then the people will be happy.

121.s:
gare vave vaṇigviṣṭau kintughne śakunau vrajet /
rājño doṣeṇa loko 'yampīḍyate sampadā samaṃ //
121.d:
गरे ववे वणिग्विष्टौ किन्तुघ्ने शकुनौ व्रजेत् /
राज्ञो दोषेण लोको ऽयम्पीड्यते सम्पदा समं //
121.m:
Should it pass in Gara, Vava, Vaṇij, Viṣṭi, Kiṃtughna, or Śakuni,
the people are afflicted along with their wealth through the ruler's fault.

121.s:
catuṣpādviṣṭivāṇijye śayitaḥ saṅkramedraviḥ /
:n
1 kṛṣṇāṣṭamīdalādūrdhvaṃ yāvacchuklāṣṭamīdalamiti
ḍa..
2 jīve candrendradaivatamiti ja..
3 indrādyapāda iti kha.. , ga.. ca / haryādyapāde iti ḍa..
4 mandākinī tatheti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / mandākinīti ceti jha..
5 tathā loka iti kha..
:p 37
durbhikṣaṃ rājasaṅgrāmo dampatyoḥ saṃśayo bhavet //
121.d:
चतुष्पाद्विष्टिवाणिज्ये शयितः सङ्क्रमेद्रविः /
:न्
1 कृष्णाष्टमीदलादूर्ध्वं यावच्छुक्लाष्टमीदलमिति
ड..
2 जीवे चन्द्रेन्द्रदैवतमिति ज..
3 इन्द्राद्यपाद इति ख.. , ग.. च / हर्याद्यपादे इति ड..
4 मन्दाकिनी तथेति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. च / मन्दाकिनीति चेति झ..
5 तथा लोक इति ख..
:प् 37
दुर्भिक्षं राजसङ्ग्रामो दम्पत्योः संशयो भवेत् //
121.m:
If the sun should ingress while lying down in Catuṣpād, Viṣṭi, or Vāṇijya,
[Footnote]
1. "kṛṣṇāṣṭamīdalādūrdhvaṃ yāvacchuklāṣṭamīdalam" in manuscript ḍa.
2. "jīve candrendradaivatam" in manuscript ja.
3. "indrādyapāde" in manuscripts kha. and ga.; "haryādyapāde" in manuscript ḍa.
4. "mandākinī tathā" in manuscripts kha., gha., and cha.; "mandākinīti ca" in manuscript jha.
5. "tathā lokaḥ" in manuscript kha. / [page] 37
there will be famine, conflict among kings, and danger between husband and wife.

121.s:
ādhāne janmanakṣatre vyādhau kleśādikaṃ bhavet /
kṛttikāyānnavadinantrirātraṃ rohiṇīṣu ca //
121.d:
आधाने जन्मनक्षत्रे व्याधौ क्लेशादिकं भवेत् /
कृत्तिकायान्नवदिनन्त्रिरात्रं रोहिणीषु च //
121.m:
In the conception-asterism or birth-asterism, affliction and the like will arise in illness;
under Kṛttikā [it lasts] nine days, and three nights in Rohiṇī;

121.s:
mṛgaśiraḥpañcarātraṃ ārdrāsu(1) prāṇanāśanaṃ /
punarvasau ca puṣye ca saptarātraṃ vidhīyate //
121.d:
मृगशिरःपञ्चरात्रं आर्द्रासु(1) प्राणनाशनं /
पुनर्वसौ च पुष्ये च सप्तरात्रं विधीयते //
121.m:
five nights in Mṛgaśiras; in Ārdrā it destroys life;
and in Punarvasu and Puṣya seven nights are prescribed.

121.s:
navarātraṃ tathāśleṣā śmaśānāntaṃ maghāsu ca /
dvau māsau pūrvaphālgunyāmuttarāsu tripañcakam(2) //
121.d:
नवरात्रं तथाश्लेषा श्मशानान्तं मघासु च /
द्वौ मासौ पूर्वफाल्गुन्यामुत्तरासु त्रिपञ्चकम्(2) //
121.m:
Likewise nine nights in Āśleṣā, and ending at the cremation ground in Maghā;
two months in Pūrvaphālgunī, and fifteen [days] in Uttarāphālgunī.

121.s:
haste tu dṛśyate citrā ardhamāsantu pīḍanam /
māsadvayantathā svātirviśākhā viṃśatirdinaṃ //
121.d:
हस्ते तु दृश्यते चित्रा अर्धमासन्तु पीडनम् /
मासद्वयन्तथा स्वातिर्विशाखा विंशतिर्दिनं //
121.m:
In Hasta, Citrā is seen [as lasting] half a month of affliction;
likewise two months in Svātī, and twenty days in Viśākhā.

121.s:
maitre caiva daśāhāni jyeṣṭhāsvevārdhamāsakam /
mūle na jāyate mokṣaḥ pūrvāṣāḍhā tripañcakam(3) //
121.d:
मैत्रे चैव दशाहानि ज्येष्ठास्वेवार्धमासकम् /
मूले न जायते मोक्षः पूर्वाषाढा त्रिपञ्चकम्(3) //
121.m:
In Anurādhā ten days, and in Jyeṣṭhā half a month;
in Mūla there is no release, in Pūrvāṣāḍhā fifteen [days];

121.s:
uttarā dinaviṃśatyā dvau māsau śravaṇena ca /
dhaniṣṭhā cārdhamāsañca vāruṇe ca daśāhakam //
121.d:
उत्तरा दिनविंशत्या द्वौ मासौ श्रवणेन च /
धनिष्ठा चार्धमासञ्च वारुणे च दशाहकम् //
121.m:
in Uttarāṣāḍhā twenty days, and two months with Śravaṇa;
Dhaniṣṭhā half a month, and in Śatabhiṣaj ten days.

121.s:
na ca bhādrapade mokṣa uttarāsu tripañcakam /
revatī daśarātrañca ahorātrantathāśvinī //
121.d:
न च भाद्रपदे मोक्ष उत्तरासु त्रिपञ्चकम् /
रेवती दशरात्रञ्च अहोरात्रन्तथाश्विनी //
121.m:
In Pūrvabhādrapadā there is no release, in Uttarabhādrapadā fifteen [days];
Revatī ten nights, and Aśvinī a day and night.

121.s:
bharaṇyāṃ prāṇahāniḥ syād gāyatrīhomataḥ śubhaṃ /
pañcadhānyatilājyādyair dhenudānandvije śamaṃ //
121.d:
भरण्यां प्राणहानिः स्याद् गायत्रीहोमतः शुभं /
पञ्चधान्यतिलाज्याद्यैर् धेनुदानन्द्विजे शमं //
121.m:
In Bharaṇī there would be loss of life; auspiciousness comes from a fire oblation with the Gāyatrī;
peace [is attained] by gifts of five grains, sesame, clarified butter, and the like, and a cow to a twice-born.

121.s:
daśā sūryasya ṣaṣṭhābdā indoḥ pañcadaśaiva tu /
aṣṭau varṣāṇi bhaumasya daśasaptadaśā budhe //
:n
1 ārdrāyāmiti ga.. , ja.. ca
2 uttarāsu trirātrakamiti jha..
3 pūrvāṣāḍhādinapañcakamiti ka.. / hastetu dṛśyante ity ādiḥ,
pūrvāṣāḍhātripañcakamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ḍa.. , cha.. ,
pustakadvaye nāsti
:p 38
daśābdāni daśā paṅgorūnaviṃśadgurordṛśā /
rāhordvādaśavarṣāṇi bhārgavasyaikaviṃśatiḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe jyotiḥśastrasāro nāma
ekaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
kālagaṇanaṃ
121.d:
दशा सूर्यस्य षष्ठाब्दा इन्दोः पञ्चदशैव तु /
अष्टौ वर्षाणि भौमस्य दशसप्तदशा बुधे //
:न्
1 आर्द्रायामिति ग.. , ज.. च
2 उत्तरासु त्रिरात्रकमिति झ..
3 पूर्वाषाढादिनपञ्चकमिति क.. / हस्तेतु दृश्यन्ते इत्य् आदिः,
पूर्वाषाढात्रिपञ्चकमित्यन्तः पाठः ड.. , छ.. ,
पुस्तकद्वये नास्ति
:प् 38
दशाब्दानि दशा पङ्गोरूनविंशद्गुरोर्दृशा /
राहोर्द्वादशवर्षाणि भार्गवस्यैकविंशतिः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे ज्योतिःशस्त्रसारो नाम
एकविंशत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्वाविंशत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
कालगणनं
121.m:
The planetary period of the Sun is six years, and of the Moon fifteen;
eight years of Mars, and the planetary period in Mercury is seventeen.
[Footnote]
1. "ārdrāyām" in manuscripts ga. and ja.
2. "uttarāsu trirātrakam" in manuscript jha.
3. "pūrvāṣāḍhādinapañcakam" in manuscript ka. / The reading from "haste tu dṛśyante" etc. up to "pūrvāṣāḍhātripañcakam" is missing in two manuscripts, ḍa. and cha. / [page] 38
Ten years is the planetary period of Saturn; nineteen is the period of Jupiter;
twelve years of Rāhu, and twenty-one of Venus.
Thus the one hundred and twenty-first chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, named "The Essence of Astral Science."
Now the one hundred and twenty-second chapter:
The Computation of Time

122.s:
agnir uvāca
kālaḥ samāgaṇo vakṣye gaṇitaṃ kālabuddhaye /
kālaḥ samāgaṇo 'rkaghno(1) māsaiś caitrādibhiryutaḥ //
122.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
कालः समागणो वक्ष्ये गणितं कालबुद्धये /
कालः समागणो ऽर्कघ्नो(1) मासैश् चैत्रादिभिर्युतः //
122.m:
Agni said:
I shall state time, the collection of years, the computation for the comprehension of time:
Time, the collection of years, multiplied by twelve, combined with the months beginning with Caitra,

122.s:
dvighno dvisṭḥaḥ savedaḥ syāt pañcāṅgaṣṭayutoguṇaḥ(2) /
triṣṭho madhyo vasuguṇaḥ punarvedaguṇaś ca saḥ //
122.d:
द्विघ्नो द्विस्ट्ःअः सवेदः स्यात् पञ्चाङ्गष्टयुतोगुणः(2) /
त्रिष्ठो मध्यो वसुगुणः पुनर्वेदगुणश् च सः //
122.m:
doubled, placed in two places, is with four; the multiplier is combined with eight, six, and five;
placed in three positions, the middle is multiplied by eight, and that again multiplied by four.

122.s:
aṣṭarandhrāgnihīnaḥ(3) syādadhaḥ saikarasāṣṭakaiḥ /
madhyo hīnaḥ ṣaṣṭihato(4) labdhayuktastathopari //
122.d:
अष्टरन्ध्राग्निहीनः(3) स्यादधः सैकरसाष्टकैः /
मध्यो हीनः षष्टिहतो(4) लब्धयुक्तस्तथोपरि //
122.m:
It should be diminished by three hundred and ninety-eight; below [it is] with eight, six, and one;
the middle, diminished, multiplied by sixty, and added to the quotient, so too above.

122.s:
nyūnaḥ saptakṛto vārastadadhastithināḍayaḥ /
saguṇo dviguṇaścoroddhvaṃ tribhirūno guṇaḥ punaḥ //
122.d:
न्यूनः सप्तकृतो वारस्तदधस्तिथिनाडयः /
सगुणो द्विगुणश्चोरोद्ध्वं त्रिभिरूनो गुणः पुनः //
122.m:
Divided by seven, it yields the weekday; below that are the nāḍīs of the lunar day;
multiplied by the multiplier and doubled above, the multiplier is again diminished by three.

122.s:
adhaḥ svarāmasaṃyukto rasārkāṣṭaphalair yutaḥ /
aṣṭāviṃśaccheṣapiṇḍastithināḍyā adhaḥ sthitaḥ //
:n
1 samāgaṇorkābda iti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 pañcadaśayuto gaṇa iti ja..
3 aṣṭacandrāgnihīna iti ja..
4 ṣaṣṭihata iti ṅa..
:p 39
122.d:
अधः स्वरामसंयुक्तो रसार्काष्टफलैर् युतः /
अष्टाविंशच्छेषपिण्डस्तिथिनाड्या अधः स्थितः //
:न्
1 समागणोर्काब्द इति ख.. , छ.. च
2 पञ्चदशयुतो गण इति ज..
3 अष्टचन्द्राग्निहीन इति ज..
4 षष्टिहत इति ङ..
:प् 39
122.m:
Below, combined with three and seven, endowed with the results of eight, twelve, and six;
twenty-eight is the remaining sum standing below the nāḍīs of the lunar day.
[Footnote]
1. "samāgaṇorkābdaḥ" in manuscripts kha. and cha.
2. "pañcadaśayuto gaṇaḥ" in manuscript ja.
3. "aṣṭacandrāgnihīnaḥ" in manuscript ja.
4. "ṣaṣṭihataḥ" in manuscript ṅa. / [page] 39

122.s:
guṇastisṛbhirūnordhaṃ dvābhyāṃ ca guṇayet punaḥ /
madhye rudraguṇaḥ kāryo hy adhaḥ saiko navāgnibhiḥ(1) //
122.d:
गुणस्तिसृभिरूनोर्धं द्वाभ्यां च गुणयेत् पुनः /
मध्ये रुद्रगुणः कार्यो ह्य् अधः सैको नवाग्निभिः(1) //
122.m:
Diminished above by three, one should multiply the product again by two;
in the middle, it should be multiplied by eleven, and below, by three hundred and ninety-one.

122.s:
labdhahīno(2) bhavenmadhyo dvāviṃśativivarjitaḥ /
ṣaṣṭiśeṣe ṛṇaṃ jñeyaṃ labdhamūrdhvaṃ vinikṣipet //
122.d:
लब्धहीनो(2) भवेन्मध्यो द्वाविंशतिविवर्जितः /
षष्टिशेषे ऋणं ज्ञेयं लब्धमूर्ध्वं विनिक्षिपेत् //
122.m:
The middle should be diminished by the quotient, deprived of twenty-two;
with sixty as remainder, a minus is to be understood; one should throw the quotient above.

122.s:
saptaviṃśatiśeṣastu dhruvo nakṣatrayogayoḥ /
māsi māsi kṣiped vārandvātriṃśadghaṭikāstithau //
122.d:
सप्तविंशतिशेषस्तु ध्रुवो नक्षत्रयोगयोः /
मासि मासि क्षिपेद् वारन्द्वात्रिंशद्घटिकास्तिथौ //
122.m:
The remainder of twenty-seven is the constant for the lunar asterisms and yogas;
month by month one should add the weekday, and thirty-two ghaṭikās to the lunar day.

122.s:
dve piṇḍe dve ca nakṣatre nāḍya ekādaśa hy ṛṇe /
vārasthāne tithindadyāt saptabhirbhārgavamāharet //
122.d:
द्वे पिण्डे द्वे च नक्षत्रे नाड्य एकादश ह्य् ऋणे /
वारस्थाने तिथिन्दद्यात् सप्तभिर्भार्गवमाहरेत् //
122.m:
Two to the sum and two to the asterism, and eleven nāḍīs in negative;
in the place of the weekday one should place the lunar day; one should divide by seven.

122.s:
śeṣavārāś ca sūryādyā ghaṭikāsu ca pātayet /
piṇḍikeṣu tithindadyāddhareccaiva caturdaśa //
122.d:
शेषवाराश् च सूर्याद्या घटिकासु च पातयेत् /
पिण्डिकेषु तिथिन्दद्याद्धरेच्चैव चतुर्दश //
122.m:
And the remaining weekdays, the Sun and others, one should drop into the ghaṭikās;
among the sums one should place the lunar day, and divide by fourteen.

122.s:
ṛṇaṃ dhanaṃ dhanamṛṇaṃ kramāj jñeyaṃ caturdaśe /
prathame trayodaśe pañca dvitīyadvādaśe daśa //
122.d:
ऋणं धनं धनमृणं क्रमाज् ज्ञेयं चतुर्दशे /
प्रथमे त्रयोदशे पञ्च द्वितीयद्वादशे दश //
122.m:
Negative, positive, positive, negative are to be known in order in the fourteen:
five in the first and thirteenth, ten in the second and twelfth,

122.s:
pañcadaśastṛtīye ca tathācaikādaśe smṛtāṃ /
caturthe daśame caiva bhavedekonaviṃśatiḥ //
122.d:
पञ्चदशस्तृतीये च तथाचैकादशे स्मृतां /
चतुर्थे दशमे चैव भवेदेकोनविंशतिः //
122.m:
fifteen in the third and likewise stated in the eleventh;
in the fourth and tenth there would be nineteen;

122.s:
pañcame navame caiva dvāviṃśatirudāhṛtāḥ /
ṣaṣṭhāṣṭame tvakhaṇḍāḥ syuś caturviṃśatireva ca //
122.d:
पञ्चमे नवमे चैव द्वाविंशतिरुदाहृताः /
षष्ठाष्टमे त्वखण्डाः स्युश् चतुर्विंशतिरेव च //
122.m:
in the fifth and ninth, twenty-two are declared;
and in the sixth and eighth they are unbroken, namely twenty-four;

122.s:
saptame pañcaviṃśaḥ syāt khaṇḍaśaḥ piṇḍikād bhavet(3) /
karkaṭādau haredrāśimṛtuvedatrayaiḥ kramāt //
122.d:
